place_name: 茶馆串串 Sichuan Pot Cafe
reviews_content: Randomly chose one of the many food spots we wanted to try in International city and this place came up and omg the Sichuan food was amazing 🇨🇳🌶️  Highly recommend⭐️:  - Sirloin -Tendon - tofu - Rice  For the base we tried 1/2 Dry spice (the spiciest) & the other 1/2 mild spicy, they were in my opinion not spicy but more numbing.  Special thanks to the servers who were really kind and guided us through the way, they made us really comfortable 👏  Can’t wait to come back soon || Quite authentic Sichuan food , delicious with nice environment and great service || A hidden gem in Dubai International City for authentic, bold 🌶️🌶️Sichuan flavors, especially for hotpot lovers. The food is flavorful and generously portioned, perfect for spice enthusiasts. While the ambiance and service are casual, the quality and value make it a must-visit for adventurous diners.😋😋 || Dear Nicole, Thank you for your warm feedback, its customer like you encourage us to continue providing fresh and good quality food. You can find us on "Come Come"app, by searching Sichuan Pot Cafe; alternatively our sister restaurant is now "Yummy Skewers Asian Cuisine" is now on talabat, so you can enjoy the same yummy favorites (and even try new ones!) from the comfort of your home or office. Plus, we’ve introduced *Special Combo*—perfect for a quick, delicious midday break!  We hope this makes it even easier for you to savor our food whenever the craving strikes. Thank you again for your support, and we can’t wait to serve you again soon. || This was a great experience! It was fun to pick a wide variety of food on sticks and extra dishes. There must have been 50 items available, from simple vegetables, mushrooms, and meats to sticks with combined foods (the beef and enoki was very good) to more exotic foods. Most of the sticks have only a little food so you can easily try many different ones.  The staff cooks them in chicken broth or spicy broth and brings it to your table. You also make your own dipping sauce combination from a dozen or more ingredients. It’s also possible to order some side dishes. I really enjoyed a spicy beef dish.  The result is really fantastic, like a hot pot but much better. The flavour of the spicy broth is fantastic, and it’s also very nice to have some in the delicious chicken broth.  Try this restaurant - you will not be disappointed! || I have been to many chinese restaurants, especially featuring Sichuanese cuisine style, and I consider myself lucky to be a little knowledgeable in this rich and interesting cuisine. This preamble said, I like this restaurant a lot :-).  It is, first of all, a chuen-chuen style restaurant, that is food is located on a skewer and is cooked in a broth. But there are three interesting points to note.  First, there is a huge variety of food on skewers, from tofu to chicken, beef, any sort of vegetables, mushrooms, and various delicious parts of an animal's body too. Skewers are freshly made every single morning, and the quality of the food is excellent, thanks! we can choose the skewers ourselves from a large open fridge, although sometimes it is good to ask for some guidance, as some delicious dishes are a bit difficult to find for us (non-chinese)...  Second point, the cooking broth. In many chuen-chuen restaurants, you have to cook the skewers yourself, and, let's be frank, we (non-chinese) never know when the food is ready to eat or not. In here -and that is amazing!- the skewers are cooked at perfection by the cooks themselves, and are presented on your table in their broth. Which is a great idea, thank you!!!!  Third point, the broth in itself is great! At the beginning, you can choose from chicken broth, which is delicate, flavourful, so nice; or fresh sichuan pepper broth, a little more intense (do you know that sichuan pepper comes in two varieties, green and red?): this is the one I like most!; spicy broth and dry spicy broth (yes, because chili has two different flavor profiles whether it is died or fresh, did you know?) You can even decide to split your skewers and have some cooked in a broth and others in another!  In the menu there are also a number of good and fresh appetizers, and I really like the quail eggs very much :-), they remind me of the tea-infused quail eggs that you can find in good teahouses in China!  So, in a nutshell, it's a great restaurant, go our and try it, I am sure you will like it!!!  Leave a comment on your experience! || I like the place. For Chinese food lovers it is very good. The staff are good and polite. The only thing is too small. I mean the the place is busy so feel like you are in food court in mall in weekend. reviews_content: From the moment we arrived, the service was outstanding. Mr. Peter, who took our order, was incredibly attentive and helpful, and all staff were equally welcoming.  They made us feel truly valued and ensured we had everything we needed throughout the meal 🙏🏻  The food arrived quickly and exceeded expectations. We enjoyed the mussels 10/10!, fried and grilled shrimp, and grilled hamoor with both red and lemon sauces (split half and half). The appetizer platter with five different options was delicious, and the sauces were rich. The complimentary bread and tea added a perfect touch to the meal.  The restaurant was clean and well-maintained, with a calm atmosphere. There’s also a prayer area and clean bathrooms upstairs, which made the visit even more convenient.  I was happy during my visit and left even happier .. highly recommended! || This restaurant can be described as one of the worst restaurants in Dubai. Food taste was below expectations. We came according to past reviews. However, we surprised of the bad taste of fish! We also had two seafood soups which were average. Two different types of rice which indicate unprofessional way of cooking. I should be creadible when I make an evaluation. I do not recommend this restaurant at all. || We had an amazing dining experience at this restaurant. Everything we tried was absolutely delicious. Even those who usually don’t like fish truly enjoyed their meals - it was that good. The staff were very friendly, attentive, and highly professional. We will definitely be coming back! 💛☝🏼👌🏼 || Food was sensational. Very sweet team as well. Some of the best crabs I’ve ever had and their house seasoning on the red snapper was to die for. Definitely recommend a pit stop here while you’re in Dubai. Completely unpretentious and great price. || First time was here and it was simply amazing! Great taste, service and overall experience. Highly recommend Hamur fish on the grill 😍 || We are delighted to hear that!! Hope you have a lovely weekend and looking forward to your next visit😊 … || I went to Sallet Al Sayad Restaurant in Dubai today and honestly had a really good experience. I ordered grilled shrimps, hammour, and mussels, and all of them were spot on. The seafood tasted fresh, everything was cooked perfectly, and the seasoning was just right without being too much. The hammour was especially good—soft, juicy, and full of flavor. The shrimps had a nice char, and the mussels were really enjoyable. I also tried their avocado hummus and loved it. It was creamy, smooth, and something I would definitely order again next time. The restaurant has a small aquarium that adds a cute touch to the place and makes the whole atmosphere feel relaxed. The staff were polite, friendly, and really helpful, which made the experience even better. Overall, I left really happy with the food and the service. If you like seafood and want somewhere comfortable with good quality dishes, I’d definitely recommend giving this place a try. || A Unique and Memorable Experience at Sallet Al Sayad Restaurant  The food here was truly something different — in the best way possible! First of all, the service is absolutely the highlight. The staff are incredibly caring, attentive, and welcoming, making us feel right at home from the moment we arrived.  One thing to note: the fish prices are per kilo, which I didn’t realize at first — but honestly, it’s worth every dirham. The fish was perfectly cooked, super fresh, and delicious. You can really taste the quality.  Everything in the restaurant was spotlessly clean, and the atmosphere was calm and inviting. I highly recommend Sallet Al Sayad to anyone looking for a great seafood experience in Dubai. I’ll definitely be coming back again! || This Authentic restaurant in Dubai is a gem. We tried many places but they had the best shrimps. Service was good and food was enjoyable. When you visit Dubai, give a chance to taste this food. || We are absolutely honored to hear such kind words!! The shrimps are our specialty item so we are glad to hear they were to your liking :)) Hope you have an awesome week ahead :)) || Amazing seafood with fresh flavors and great presentation. The service was warm and attentive, and the ambience made the dining experience even better. Definitely a place worth visiting again! || Excellent seafood restaurant! The fish was very fresh, perfectly cooked, and full of flavor. The service was friendly and professional, and the atmosphere was clean and welcoming. Definitely one of the best places for seafood — highly recommended! || ⸻  The food at the restaurant was outstanding. We had sea bass, and it was one of the best fish dishes we’ve had in years. We went there with our family, and our one-year-old son absolutely loved it. The huge aquarium kept him fascinated the whole time, and the staff were wonderfully patient with him. Sumita took great care of our son while we were eating, which allowed us to truly relax || Thank you so much for such a wonderful review!  We’re truly delighted that you and your family enjoyed your visit and hope you have a lovely day :)) || The fish was amazing! Perfectly grilled and seasoned, really enjoyed it. Also listen to the waiter - they can give you a good advice if you are not certain what to choose 😊. The complimentary tea was a nice touch! There are a bit delays with the service, but it actually gives you a chance to relax and enjoy the time. Overall would recommend due to the food! || Thanks a million Elena!! We truly appreciate such kind words!! || What a find… I’m so pleased we decided to venture to this side of town to try, what has turned out to be, my new favourite seafood restaurant in Dubai. The shrimp were outstanding - all the food, including the hummus and bread and vegetable plate, was incredibly fresh and tasted wonderful  - but the shrimp were just out of this world. My husband champions the squid as being ‘the best he’s had’.  Such a memorable meal; for the quality, simplicity and genuine hospitality. We will be back. || Food was delicious Service was excellent and they also provided cover for our seating area which helped our family eat comfortably. Definitely worth it especially if you are a sea food lover 👌😊👍 || It was really amazing experience, all food , grill shrimp, fish, sayadi rice, delicious, perfect staff, recommend to everyone || Thanks a million for the kind words!! We truly appreciate it:)) || Very nice local restaurant, delicious food and friendly service. Convenient to reach and easy parking. || One of the best seafood restaurant in Dubai.  Highly recommended. It was my first time but I am sure it will be my favorite seafood place. || Thanks a million Marwan for the kind words!! You can take a look to the bill for more information. || I had the most amazing birthday and the food was amazing! Rayban was really helpful.  We ordered the 176 dapma special with cajun sauce. The shrimp was well cooked, it was soft to chew, the mussels were fresh and the crab was perfect. They also served 2 drinks with the dampa special. Overall it was the greatest experience, to the point where we were in food coma until the next morning.  The staff is cheerful, always on their toes to help, and sweetest when they’re singing the birthday song for you.  PS: Cajun was a bit on the sweeter end so if you prefer for something spicy, just ask the restaurant to suggest you something other than cajun sauce. || Had an amazing seafood feast at Dampa Seafood! The food was super fresh, flavorful, and really satisfying, especially the sauces, which were perfectly balanced and not too overpowering. The overall vibe was fun and perfect for sharing a big meal with friends or family.  They also celebrated my birthday, which was such a lovely surprise and made the experience even more special. Special thanks to Ian for the excellent service, very attentive, friendly, and made sure everything was well taken care of.  Definitely coming back again! || I had a wonderful experience at this seafood restaurant. The food was savory and fresh, offering a new way of eating (手拿).  I appreciated the thoughtful touches, such as the alcohol pads, gloves, tissues, and everything else you might need. The music and vibe were amazing and vibrant, creating a fantastic atmosphere.  JM, one of the workers, was very nice and always ready to help, ensuring I had everything I needed instantly. || Here’s a polished, balanced version of your review while keeping it honest and constructive:  We ordered the Cajun Spice Seafood Mix. The portion size was quite generous and easily sufficient for three people. Overall, it was good; however, the taste felt a bit on the milder side compared to other seafood restaurants we’ve tried. We also felt that it had a bit too much oil, which may have reduced the overall flavor. Perhaps using less oil would enhance the taste. Next time, we’ll definitely try a different flavor. || I visited the restaurant with my friend and had a wonderful dining experience. The Cajun grilled seafood was perfectly cooked, flavorful, and very satisfying. Our server Reiven provided excellent service, friendly and attentive throughout our visit. Another staff member also assisted us with great care unfortunately, I couldn’t recall his name, but his service was equally appreciated. Overall, a pleasant experience with great food and service. I would gladly recommend this restaurant. || We recently visited Dampa Baniyas with my family, sponsored by my nieces, to celebrate my sister-in-law’s post-birthday  and we had such an amazing time!  The food was delicious, especially the Cajun seafoods super fresh and flavorful. A big shout-out to the staff Ericson, Jeff, Renz and Justin for their great service. They were friendly, attentive, and made our dining experience even better.  Highly recommended! Will definitely come back. 👍🦐🦀🍽️ || Excellent seafood! Everything was delicious and fresh. Special thanks to Kuya Popoy for the wonderful service, he was very nice, friendly, and accommodating. We truly enjoyed our experience and will definitely come back! || Fresh, Flavorful & Fun Dining Experience!  Had an amazing time at Dumpa Seafood Grill! The food was absolutely delicious — fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. We loved the seafood boil style, especially the rich sauces that complemented the shrimp, crabs, and mussels so well. The portions were generous, and everything tasted super fresh.  The staff were friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience enjoyable. The place has a lively, casual vibe that’s perfect for families or groups of friends who love good seafood and a relaxed atmosphere.  Highly recommend Dumpa Seafood Grill if you’re craving fresh seafood with bold flavors and great service. Can’t wait to come back! 🦀🦐🍤 || Great food, we had the huge bucket that has clams, mussels, crab & shrimps with the cajun sauce. You also get unlimited rice with it. The sauce was extraordinardy & so were the clams & shrimps. Crab was not crabing overall but at least next time we know what to order. We also tried the fries which were really good, ordered an extra portion of corn & an extra portion of cajun shrims & fried calamari. All this for 90 aed per person! You also get two liters of their house made drinks (weird names & weirder colors) but taste is there. The place is located in port saaeed in a surprisingly calm area. It is definitely a hidden gem & would definitely go back there. Highly recommmended! || It’s always a great experience dining at Dampa. This time it is dinner with friends. The consistency of their sumptous dishes never diminishes which keeps us coming back. Thank you Anton for the commendable service! || The food was absolutely amazing, and the service Kelvin provided was outstanding. I mentioned to him that it was my birthday, and they went above and beyond by organizing a whole birthday celebration just for me. It made me feel incredibly special.  It was my first time visiting the restaurant and I truly loved the entire experience. Everything—from the food to the atmosphere to the service—was perfect. I will definitely be coming back! || Excellent seafood and outstanding service. The staff (Miko and Renz) were friendly, attentive, and made us feel very welcome. The quality of the food was fantastic, and the overall experience was thoroughly enjoyable. Would happily return. || We had an absolutely wonderful experience thanks to our server, JM. From the moment we sat down, he greeted us with a warm and friendly smile, and it only got better from there. The service was attentive but not overbearing, and they were very knowledgeable about the menu. They made great recommendations and checked in on us at just the right times, ensuring we had everything we needed.  What really stood out was their professionalism and positive attitude—no request was too much, and they made our dining experience truly enjoyable. The food arrived at the perfect temperature, and the pacing was spot on. We left feeling genuinely cared for, and we can’t wait to come back!  Thank you, JM, for making our visit so memorable. You’ve earned our loyalty and a well-deserved tip! || Today is my birthday and we chose Dampa Seafood Grill to spend our humble celebration dinner. Kuya JM, one of the crews, is THE BEST and most entertaining server that I’ve ever encountered. KUDOS! 🥰🥰🤍🤍 One of my most memorable and wholesome birthday celebrations ever! I turned 23 and it’s my first time having crews sung for me 😣🤍 I’m so happy!! || Superrrbb the food, ambiance and service!  The service was quick at the time of our visit. Kudos to Jeff and Miko for the service!! We love Dampa♥️  Will def recommend to friends/ family! || First time in Dubai and our friend brought us to Dampa Seafood Grill. We ordered the Cajun seafood mix, which was flavorful and well portioned but much milder than expected. It could definitely use more heat. The grilled squid was nicely cooked but was unremarkable. The standout of the meal was the Salty Eggperience shrimp, rich, savory, and the one dish I would come back for. The meal came with unlimited rice, which was appreciated and perfect for soaking up the sauces. Drinks included mocktails, though they were overly sweet and not very balanced. Service was friendly overall, but we did have to follow up on a couple of dishes that were delayed. One downside worth mentioning was the noticeable presence of flies, which was distracting during the meal. Overall, Dampa offers a fun, communal seafood experience with a few solid dishes, but better spice levels, smoother service, and improved cleanliness would make a big difference. || So we had dinner me and my wife and the food was very good seafood Cajun boodle with unlimited drinks and rice and service was very nice! I appreciate ravier for taking care of us while we dine. His service was awesome and he took care of us. From start to finish Thank you sir and dampa team more power to you! || The food remains as delicious as always! This was my nth visit to Dampa, and despite it being a busy holiday evening, I was pleasantly surprised by the reasonable wait times for both seating and service.  Special thanks to Jeff for his outstanding service. Dampa should really recognize staff members like Jeff more – even during the hectic rush with customers constantly coming and going, he maintained a cheerful attitude and took excellent care of us.  We left the restaurant completely satisfied and in great spirits. The views are absolutely the highlight of this restaurant. The proximity to the Dubai Fountain water show and the direct view of the Burj Khalifa make the setting truly impressive and memorable.  Some of the dishes were good, though overall the food felt average for a new restaurant with this level of location and ambition. There’s potential, but it didn’t fully stand out yet.  Service was okay, but for a restaurant of this caliber, I expected better. We had to ask multiple times for water and for assistance from our server, which took away from the overall experience.  In summary, it’s worth visiting for the view and atmosphere, but there’s room for improvement in both service and consistency to truly match the setting. || I visited this restaurant yesterday and had a wonderful experience. I was very impressed by the quality of the food and the excellent service. All the staff were friendly, helpful, and welcoming. Special thanks to the gentleman  Mr TAMER  who gave me such a warm welcome. would also like to thank the chef and the behind-the-scenes kitchen team—the real unsung heroes—who prepare such delicious food.   Highly recommended! || ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I had an excellent experience at Hikaros Restaurant. The atmosphere was warm, the food was flavorful, and everything was served fresh and beautifully presented. But what truly made the visit exceptional was the service. Khalil, one of the waiters, was outstanding — polite, attentive, quick, and genuinely professional. He anticipated what we needed before we even asked and made the whole experience smooth and enjoyable. I really appreciate this level of service. Definitely coming back. || You don’t need a white tablecloth for a fine dining experience! Icarus has a wonderfully casual chic atmosphere right on the Dubai fountain (great view of the water shows!). The staff were efficient and welcoming. The food was some of the most visually beautiful I have ever eaten. They clearly put a lot of effort into the small details.  The sweet potato coconut soup was incredible! I am admittedly a soup fanatic, but it was my favorite part of the meal. Creamy and curry-licious with perfectly balanced flavors. Next was a jump to Korea for the bao buns (the menu reallyy is Meditter-Asian). They came with a fresh peppery arugula salad and a sweet sticky sauce that makes a bao bun happy. I finished with the traditional Sayadia fish which was a HUGE portion served over rice.  I love a lot of the great restaurants around the Dubai mall, but.I found Icarus head and shoulders above the others in food presentation and attention to balanced flavors. I can’t wait to go back! || This is an amazing restaurant to eat, drink, and watch the evening fountain show - all while enjoying the light show on and around the Burj Khalid. We had T-bone steak and our son had baked chicken. All was delicious and our steaks were done to perfection (both well-done and medium).  Staff was very accommodating and friendly. It’s open air seating so some cigarette smoke drifted through occasionally. || I ate French onion soup and fish and chips for the child, both of which tasted burnt! As for my husband's food, it wasn't wow either! Only the kunafe was good! Huge prices for almost zero taste! Just because it is very well positioned with a good view of the Burj Khalifa and after an extraordinarily beautiful show you can kind of forget the taste experience which is not at all what you expect!Atmosphere 5 stars just jor the Burj Khalifa show! || This place is awesome! By far the best place to watch the Burj fountain show. Aside from the view, the food is outstanding! The menu is also exceptional! The bar has reasonable selections, and you can also order Sheesha there. The vibe is chill, and actually it is kind of Mediterranean.  We ordered some soups, sushi, and some salads. I had the best sweet potato fries I've ever had in my life! I had some kabob and I don't know what it's called. Soooo good. I have a picture of it here, so if you want to try it, just show them this. It's some sliced beef and lamb combined on a kabob. VERY flavorful and light surprisingly.  Back to the salad, it was the nicoise, and it was delicious. Everything about it. Highly recommended. The mushroom soup was also very flavorful, and not to creamy.  They also have a DJ booth, and the bar atmosphere is very cool. Super fun place. I have been twice in 2 weeks. || Absolutely amazing! The food was outstanding – fresh, full of flavor, and beautifully presented. The service was super friendly and attentive, making us feel truly welcome. The stunning view made the whole experience unforgettable. Highly recommended – I’ll definitely be coming back! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ || Went for dinner at Icarus and had a wonderful experience. The food was tasty and well-seasoned. I also forgot my sunglasses when I left, and the staff kindly kept them aside for me.  A special shoutout goes to the host, Jeraldine. She was warm, friendly, and always smiling, which made the entire experience at Icarus truly memorable. Thank you! || The meal was outstanding. The food arrived hot, and every dish was flavorful and perfectly prepared. This restaurant delivers high quality cuisine consistently. What truly elevated the evening was our server, Anushka. She provided exceptional service, making the experience memorable. Anushka was attentive without being intrusive. She offered excellent recommendations when we asked about the menu specials. She made sure our glasses were full and cleared plates promptly. Her genuine warmth and professional efficiency created a comfortable and welcoming atmosphere. Ask for her section. Her service deserves five stars alone. || Quick and fast service with patient service. Mhan helped us a lot with honest recommendation for food and drinks. I took the fish and chips and my girlfriend the grilled Prawns. Both dishes were great. || Tasty food and good service, location is perfect to watch the fountain show👌🏻 Prices are a bit high but considering the location you can’t expect less. The restaurant gets full closer to 6 pm || The food and drinks are really delicious and they have good prices. The portions are not very big but they are just right especially if you get a side like a salad or sushi. Our waiter was Nadim. The man was very friendly helpful and always somewhere near if we wanted something extra. A big plus for this place is the fact that the burj khalifa is on the opposite side and you have a perfect view of the magical fountain show. || A great location to watch the Fountain show while having Shisha on the side. The food was delicious and the shisha was good. Thanks to the good service of Annushka and Ali. || Not great, not terrible. Decent experience. Quite expensive compared to similar other restaurants. || Amazing dining experience at Icarus Dubai! The steak and lobster were cooked to perfection, and the views of Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain made it unforgettable. Our server, Khalil, was exceptional — attentive and welcoming. A bit pricey, but absolutely worth it for the food, service, and ambiance! || Everything is great, but the prices are extremely inflated double the prices or even the triple of any restaurant in that area! || We had a pleasant time here and watched the fountain show at the same time. The food was delicious, we ordered a selection of appetizers, the french onion soup was exquisite. I highly recommend the fish Sadiyat. The service was amazing thanks to Krishna. Thank you || One of the restaurants I truly enjoyed! The food quality was excellent — especially the fish and chips, which were absolutely amazing. I highly recommend trying it. Special thanks to our waiter, Noel, who made our experience exceptional! || Overall, it was a nice experience. The view is definitely worth it, but the food is quite expensive for the quality.

We wanted fresh fish with local options for entrees next to the beautiful Burj Al Arab and Sardina did not disappoint! The service was exceptional, the food was very beautifully presented and delicious. We were able to pick our own fresh fish and they had so many tasty options on their menu. The prices were not scary either. We were greeted with smiles and the place was very clean too, and to make everything extra special, we loved the view! Now we are on our way to the beach which is just a few minutes away walking. || Best seafood I've ever had... From the quality and freshness of the seafood to their seasoning... every aspect is simply exceptional Went back twice in a trip of 4 days. That already says a lot. Staff extremely professional and very friendly❤️ Would definitely come again || Our family of four had an exceptional lunch at Sardina Seafood Restaurant. The fish was absolutely delicious—fresh, perfectly cooked, and full of flavor. The seafood dishes were just as impressive, beautifully prepared and seasoned. The service was fantastic: attentive, friendly, and professional throughout the meal. We truly enjoyed every moment and would love to come back again. || Sardina seafood restaurant that was truly a great experience with excellent service. I had dinner here with my partner, and we enjoyed our meal on the restaurant’s terrace. Right at the beginning, they served us a complimentary welcome dish made with shellfish and pasta, which was absolutely delicious. The main course was also excellent, and the staff were very friendly and professional. Highly recommended if you’re looking for good seafood.” || The sea-food and fish looked fresh. The menu is varied with multiple cooking styles. The ambiance is nice and the service is quick but the seafood smell is overpowering indoors. All the items ordered were delicious and the staff were polite and friendly, Mahmoud made us feel welcomed. I would recommend the grilled shrimps opened with a side sauce of butter & dill. The restaurant is on the first floor and parking inside the mall is free for the first 2 hours. || We visited this restaurant with my family, and the experience was excellent. The food was very delicious, and the staff were extremely kind and welcoming. Thank you to everyone, and I highly recommend visiting 👍🏼 || I ordered pink sauce spaghetti with shrimps, a supreme fish, herrings tahini, and fresh juices. They were all good. The portions were huge!! The service was amazing, they gave me complementary items (appetizers and a dessert) || Fantastic food ! Highly recommended sea food. reviews_content: I am currently here, and I must say the overall experience has been very pleasant. The staff are extremely friendly, welcoming, and always ready to assist, which immediately creates a warm and comfortable atmosphere. Their positive attitude and professionalism truly enhance the guest experience. I was pleasantly surprised by the coconut coffee, which was completely new to me. The flavor was rich, smooth, and perfectly balanced, making it a truly enjoyable and memorable drink. It was a unique experience that stood out and added a special touch to my stay. Additionally, the chocolate cookie chip  treat was beautifully presented. The attention to detail in the presentation reflected care and thoughtfulness, making it feel special rather than ordinary. Small gestures like this leave a lasting impression and show the team’s commitment to quality and guest satisfaction. || The place - A small concept café, but very nice. Cozy atmosphere and a pleasant place to relax or work. Quiet.  The staff - warm, soulful  Be sure to ask for Richard & Joan  Prices - reasonable || Great food and service! The place is bright and cozy perfect if you want to read a book, bring your laptop, or just catch up with friends. Highly recommended! || It’s awesome place to have coffee, and not only coffee. Also brunch and lunch. Thank you for your professional service Richard and Joan! || Lovely place to have a coffee around this area. Service is great! Special thanks to Richard. || Extremely unreasonable and inhospitable owner.  The cafe is literally empty with only me and one other person. Bunch of empty tables everywhere. I bought a drink and had finished it while I was doing work, and the owner required me to order something else to continue working there or I had to leave. Why should I order something if I’m not hungry? It’s not as if I’m freeloading. Should I have just drunk my coffee at snail’s pace? I was not even being disruptive and it wasn’t as if there was a queue of patrons waiting to dine in. Make it make sense.  Will absolutely not be back. Do not come here if you’re looking for some place to park yourself, you will be unceremoniously asked to leave despite the cafe being completely vacant.  Service staff were impeccable. Polite and apologetic, and they tried everything in their power to make my experience better. || I absolutely love Grind me fine coffee house. The coffee is perfectly brewed, extracted and delicious food. Beyond the great coffee, the atmosphere  is fantastic and the background music makes it the perfect spot to relax. Highly Recommended!" || Amazing Coffee and Breakfast. The Coffe tastes like coffee and you can smell the roast. Not like this standard coffee you can get from Star for lot of bucks.  Also the service is great, all parts of the Menue you get explained not only what’s inside but also why it’s special. And after you receive your dich you understand why it was explained so good. All amazing here!  Latte Macchiato, cappuccino, espresso, Coffee, eggs, guacamole 🥑 bread, juices, iced coffee and tea, cakes, you will love it! || Really lovely cafe with an African vibe - well worth venturing out from the corporate chains. Friendly staff and a great coffee. It was a little tough to find as there are clothes for sale along one wall and at first I mistook it for a clothes store || I love this place. This is a gem. The coffee is very good and the snacks that we had is awesome. The place is small but so cozy. They have unique flavors of coffee to choose from. The owners are so accommodating and very kind to us. Customer service needs improvement because it’s too busy, taking my order takes time. No one offered me the menu so I scanned the QR code of the menu from a nearby table by zooming into my camera 🤦‍♀️ okay to try once but this place is not for me. I find better cafes with same quality food but excellent customer service and quiet. 🤷‍♀️ Nothing special in this place. || Great breakfast spot ! Its famous for the cloud matcha drink but im not a fan of matcha ! But still worth the try with coconut milk .. mozarella sandwich and egg bun were good too!! || Love this place. Ambiance was really nice, drinks were good, service was fantastic. Please respect the wishes of your customers || Great coffee and atmosphere! They have Ethiopian beans and interesting selection of desserts. We tried chocolate chips  cookies  and it was perfect. Visited this place for hot chocolate, and it was totally worth it. The hot chocolate was rich, smooth, and honestly the best part of the visit.  The breakfast, though, was pretty average and didn’t match what I expected — they can definitely improve there. Overall, I’d go back, but only for the hot chocolate because that’s the one thing I really loved.  Overall Rating: 4/5 Food: 3/5 Ambience: 4.5/5 Service: 4/5  #hotchocolatelover #foodreview #dubaieats #foodie honestreview || From the moment I walked in, I felt genuinely welcomed. The atmosphere in this coffee shop is amazing – a perfect mix of cozy and stylish, with a warm and inviting feeling as soon as you take a seat. It’s the kind of place where you instantly feel relaxed and want to stay longer.  The customer service was outstanding, and I have to give special thanks to Emmanuell Champ, who gave me one of the best customer service experiences I’ve ever had. He took the time to explain the menu clearly, offered helpful recommendations, and made sure everything was perfect throughout my visit. His professionalism, friendliness, and genuine passion for his work made a big difference.  The food and drinks were exceptional. The cheesecake was unbelievably delicious – soft, creamy, and topped with rich, melted chocolate that tasted like real quality, not something mass-produced. Their hot chocolate is honestly one of the best I’ve ever had – thick, smooth, and full of deep chocolate flavour. Even the cappuccinos were beautifully made, with great latte art and the perfect balance of flavour.  Everything was served clean and beautifully presented, and the overall environment was spotless. You can see the team takes real pride in both the quality and the cleanliness of the place.  In summary, this coffee shop delivers on every level: great atmosphere, exceptional service, high-quality food and drinks, and a level of care that truly sets it apart. I highly recommend visiting – and make sure to ask for Emmanuell Champ; he will make your experience even better. I’ll definitely be back! || Said Dal 1923 at Mall of the Emirates is an amazing spot for dessert lovers. I love Emmanuel and amisha The atmosphere is cozy, elegant, and perfect for a coffee break or a sweet treat after shopping. Their San Sebastian cheesecake is truly exceptional — creamy, rich, and perfectly balanced. One of the best I’ve tried in Dubai. The service is friendly, and the presentation of every dish makes the experience even better. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality desserts in a great setting! || Hands down the best brunch I’ve had (and I’ve had a lot)! We ordered the french toast and truffle poached avo and it was so delicious and cooked to perfection. Upset it was our last day in Dubai when we tried this or we would have certainly gone for breakfast and would have even tried it for dinner!  Thank you Emmanuel! || If I could give more than 5 stars, I would! The experience at SAID DAL 1923 was absolutely delightful from start to finish.  The highlight for me was the strawberry cheesecake – hands down one of the best I’ve ever had. The texture was rich and creamy, perfectly balanced with a slightly tangy strawberry flavor, and topped with fresh whipped cream and a juicy strawberry. It was insane good and definitely worth coming back for on its own.  Their coffee deserves a special mention too. Smooth, strong, and served with a perfect heart design on top – a small touch that makes the experience even more enjoyable. It paired beautifully with the desserts and left a warm finish.  We also tried the vanilla ice cream with crisp cookies on top, which was a refreshing balance of creamy sweetness and crunch. On the side, the strawberry sauce was bursting with fresh flavor, adding an extra layer to the desserts.  What really ties everything together here is the friendly and welcoming staff. Service was prompt, cheerful, and attentive without being intrusive, making the whole visit feel even more special.  Overall, this spot nails it in terms of food, drinks, and atmosphere. Definitely one of the best dessert and coffee experiences in Dubai Mall of the Emirates. Highly recommended for anyone with a sweet tooth!  ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ || Khaled, we really appreciate the time you have taken to give us such a detailed feedback and thank you so much for your 5-star rating! We’re delighted to hear you enjoyed the food and coffee. Our full team, from the chefs to the service team put a lot of heart into every dish and every detail of the experience, so it means the world to know it made a difference. We can’t wait to welcome you back soon for more good food and good memories.” || Amazing food and service.  Emmanuel Champ greeted us and made us feel welcomed. He patiently introduced the desserts that suit us.  We ordered the pistachio tiramisu and hot chocolate which were awesome!  Higly recommend! || An amazingly friendly welcome from the moment we walked in. I came with my mum to celebrate my birthday with breakfast- Emmanuel was attentive and helpful with our food choices and preferences. I would highly recommend Said as a place to enjoy good food with a very calming atmosphere. || This is such an inviting spot with a warm ambiance and a true Italian flair. From the coffee to the beautifully crafted desserts, everything feels thoughtfully done.  What made my experience extra special was Emmanuel — or Champ. He is very attentive, genuine, and friendly. Emmanuel took the time to recommend the perfect pairing, and his suggestion of the Triple Chocolate Mocha with the Amaretto Biscuit was absolutely spot-on (highly recommended!).  Highly recommend this place — and make sure you ask Champ for his favourites! || It was my first time in SAID ROMA at mall of the emirates but never the last time for sure because of such wonderful experience with such energetic staff. Loved the Ambience and the simplicity with elegance of the presentation I would Love to thank Francis for the  welcoming assisting me  to my table… thank you Anish for showing the best selling food and beverages information and of course I never forget to mention Champion( Emmanuel) for his endless gratitude and beautiful way to honor a guest by making them feel really comfortable with the place people and the Aroma of the place💯🫶 Thank you to the entire team of DIAL DAL 1923 for preparing such amazing food. That really thick spicy full authentic and miraculous flavor is not just a cup! It’s an experience! While Emmanuel “CHAMP” confidence was 1000% in place, I just can’t recommend Said DAL 1923 place enough! And honestly I now believe I am really lucky!!  “Pics talk ;)” || Only tried their Famous Hot Chocolate and LOVED IT. I personally liked this branch better than the one in London. Our favorite was the hazelnut flavor for Hot chocolate. || If you’re looking for the best hot chocolate in the UAE, this is the place to be! The flavors are rich, indulgent, and absolutely unforgettable—you simply can’t come here just once. Every sip feels like pure comfort.  A special shoutout to Champ and Ameesha for their warm and attentive service—they truly make the experience even better. Highly recommend—thank me later! || My friends took me here for the first time and definitely it will not be my last time here. It is the best hot chocolate and brownie I've ever had. The service from Emmanuel and Francis is 10/10. The music too is soo soothing and end enjoyable. We'll come again. || Love the food here. We ordered Grandma Cake and Hot Chocolate. The combination of Peanut Butter and Chocolate is superb. The location ambiance is good too for a relaxing coffee hangout. The staff are amazing too. We were assisted by Emmanuel and he is very accommodating and helpful. Overall experience is great. A place worth visiting. || We were looking for a cozy place to have coffee, and encountered SAID, which got our attention because of the chocolate.  After seeing one server carrying a "milk bottle" dripping with chocolate, I decided to try one. Went for the Pistachio Frap, which was good. Could've been more "Pistachioy", but it was enjoyable.  The pastries on their display looked so good! Next time I will have to try one. || Must try hot chocolate in dubai!! They have the best hot chocolate and pastries they have the famous chocolate cake and cheese cake. But don’t forget to buy the hot chocolate!!! Mr. Emmanuel did a great service and such an energetic person!! It is a work friendly cafe too!!! || Tried their hot chocolate and it was really good—thick, chocolatey, and not overly sweet. Served hot and comforting, perfect for chilling out. Such a cozy cup of hot chocolate 🍫 Smooth, rich, and warming—exactly what I needed. Would definitely order again. || One of the best breakfasts i’ve had in Dubai. This is really a hidden gem (literally - we took time finding it) but it’s so worth it. Emmanuel gave us amazing service - he was very hospitable and done things with a smile. Was very friendly and service was excellent. Even made us try some free chocolate after the meal. Food is amazing, price on the higher side but honestly worth it. The tiramisu is the best I’ve ever had in Dubai. We’ve had the ones in Italy and this is the closest you can get in Dubai. Truly an authentic experience. I had the eggs your way and my husband tried the salmon omelette and it was great. The avocado and omelette was very flavorful and you can tell it was made with effort and not just slabbed on like usual places. We’ll come back here again for sure. Coffee is great too - you can’t go wrong with this place. 10/10 || We were exhausted from all the shopping and we found this amazing spot. It has the best hot chocolate and amazing service. We would like to thank our server Emmanuel Champ for spectacular service, he is the best server!!!! Definetely recommend stopping by and having some hot chocolate! || I came here for a quick snack before meeting friends. I was greeted by the friendly & kind "Emmanuel" who helped me with the choice of my cappuccino & dessert. He recommended the San Sebastian Cioccolato Triple Chocolate signature plate & it was insanely delicious. One of the most creamy & perfectly baked San Sebastian cakes I have tried. In addition, the triple chocolate cappucino cup was very well-balanced & not as insanely sweet as the hot chocolate cup. Emmanuel was great with his service & ensured everything was to my liking. Although I usually go to Said Dal in City Walk, this branch at MOE is one of my favourites now due to the amazing service & lovely staff. Overall, I had a very pleasant experience as this is my most favourite chocolate dessert place & I will definitely be back soon! || Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re thrilled to hear you had a great experience with us.  It truly means a lot to our team, and we can’t wait to welcome you back again soon for another visit.

My absolute go to in downtown. Happy Hour is amazing, the view is killer, and the food is tasty. Highly recommend.  Ahmed is also a fantastic shisha mixologist! Vilma is excellent at hosting and serving the folks here. || Seated promptly on arrival after booking the best seats and table over 3 months ago. Lovely staff to start with. Very helpful however pushy to order things we did not want or need. Advising water multiple times and more small bites.  We had amazing seating overlooking the fountain and show! Lots of epic displays and awesome music.  We had a range of food, including truffle items, everything tasted delightful, fresh and fragrant.  We even opted for desert as we enjoyed ourselves so much. We can highly recommend anything with truffle, we are huge fans!  We arrived in happy hour so drinks were slightly discounted. The bill includes a service charge and the restaurant has a minimum spend.  Despite this when we went to pay, we were offered to increase the tip and the member of staff even asked if we were leaving anything for them.  We are from the UK and its not normal for us to tip. However always agree to the service charge.  Apart from the pushy staff, its a stunning place and we highly recommend booking in advance.  Overall we really enjoyed it. || This place was fabulous! Raju took fantastic care of us from start to finish! He surprised us with a Birthday cake and song for my husbands birthday! Great views! Great food and drinks! Definitely make reservations for a terrace view to get in the lightshow! || Rahul was exceptional. He was attentive and very knowledgeable about the menu. Service was fast! We had front row on the rail for the first day of the fountain reopening, and it was just awesome! It will be memorable. The music at the restaurant was great, a lot of Queen, my favorite! || Excellent views of the Burj Khalifa and the fountain shows. Many reviews say it’s one of the best spots for seeing the show while dining.  Repeated praise for friendly, attentive, helpful staff. Reviewers often mention a warm welcome and good attentiveness especially mariel. || Fabulous place to eat a nice meal while admiring the beautiful city lights and fountain show. Customer service is top notch! Food is delicious. Can easily make reservations online if needed. || The view of Burj Khalifa and the fountains is amazing! Especially if you get front row seating. We had the wagyu burger which was good. Drinks are also fine although much pricier than expected. I have to deduct a star for the happy birthday singing. You guys had like 4 or 5 birthdays in the same night and the banging and loud singing for them was obnoxious, especially during the times there were fountain shows. You should really drop the birthday singing act, it spoils the atmosphere for everyone else to be honest || We celebrated our wedding anniversary in this beautiful place. The food was delicious, and it was served very quickly. The service was excellent, and we would like to express our gratitude to the waitress, Kath. The restaurant provided a very pleasant compliment and a delicious cake. Additionally, the view of the Fountains and the Burj Khalifa was breathtaking. || Attended without a reservation and were found a table very quickly (despite being incredibly busy). We were even able to watch the fountain and light shows from our seats!  The food and drink were fabulous and the service was exceptional too. Many thanks to Kath and Abdul for looking after us! We would definitely come back again! || The Tap House Downtown is a fantastic spot with breathtaking views of the Burj Khalifa and the dancing fountain. The atmosphere is lively yet relaxed, making it perfect for any occasion. The food is delicious with full of flavour and beautifully served. The service is top-notch, with super friendly staff who make you feel truly welcome. This place is a perfect mix of great food, amazing views, and a wonderful vibe. Definitely a place worth visiting again!! || The food was excellent very tasty. it’s a relaxing atmosphere even though right near the fountains. The service was very professional, our servers Kath & Rahul were very attentive and cheerful. Good experience all round.  Thank you 🙏 || Food was shocking in regard to being tasteless. Also overpriced. I get the fact people come here to eat and watch the fountain. But that’s no excuse for poor food. Service was good though. Service was added on top. I ended up paying just shy of 350aed which is £84 for a mediocre at best meal, and a couple of drinks. || Kath was an awesome server. So pleasant and courteous.  The whole staff was amazing.  We were running late cause of traffic  and  they continued to hold our table till we got there.  Held our front row table.  We absolutely recommend the Tap House. || In front of the Burj Khalifa to?er with a great water show each 30 minutes. Nice place, with tasty food, meat, fish, veggy. From starter to desert all was really tasty. A large choice of drinks. The staff is very professionnal and available. I recommend. || I’m leaving this review here only because the new restaurant of the same network in Creek Harbor is not yet listed on Google Maps.  Please note: this did NOT happen in this branch, but in the new Creek Harbor location.  During our visit, a small stone (approximately 5 mm) was found in the sauce served with the Fish and Chips. My husband almost damaged his tooth biting into it. Fortunately, no serious injury occurred, but the situation was quite alarming.  Since this is a new restaurant, I assume processes may still be in setup, but finding a stone in food is obviously unacceptable. I’m sharing this only as a warning to be careful, especially when ordering dishes with sauces.  I hope the management of the new Creek Harbor restaurant takes this seriously and improves quality control. || The atmosphere is great,  the view is amazing and the music is fun. Service was excellent too, Kath und Rajh were very nice. The cocktail could be better,  it was not bad but I've drinked much better for much less. I can understand the price for the location but the quality could be better. Anyway the overall experience was excellent and I can recommend the place without doubt. || We celebrated our anniversary at The Tap House and it was a wonderful experience! It was the first night the fountains were back on and the view is top tier!! Our waiter, Marisa was excellent and went above and beyond for our anniversary by giving us an extra free dessert. The smashed pavlova was my favorite dessert I had in Dubai. || A large, typical Tap House restaurant with large wall TVs that make it ideal for sports watching.  The view to Dubai fountain isn’t as great as the upper floors of Souq Al Bahar, but it’s still one of the greatest spots to watch the Dubai Fountain show especially in winter when you can sit outside.  Food also is good, although serving size (for the salads, for example) could be a bit larger  Park at the Souq Al Bahar basement (have your license plates validated in the restaurant). || We really had a good time and just a perfect place to watch the fountain show. Food and Service are both excellent. Big thanks to Kale, Luisa and Rose who were very attentive and helpful to our requests. Definitely recommending The Tap House! 😍 || Amazing. Booked with quite short notice for our anniversary and they accommodated me with a front row seat to the fountain show. Then surprised us with a happy anniversary cake. Made our night - the views, food and service were incredible. Our waiter Rahul made us feel so special and couldn’t do enough. Really recommend the Tap House when in Dubai!!

One of our favorite places as a family. Wonderful ambiance (as always and expected), great service and generous tasty portions. Their burgers, steaks and fajitas are all good and rich. Even better, entertainer works like a charm! || It's great to hear comments from our longtime fans, we appreciate it! || Good Vibes only. The food is great here but for me its the overall experience that just makes it a go to place.. great food, amazing service, great music, kind faces, plenty of seating. Its like Christmas everyday. I’ll definitely be coming back again! || Thank you for taking the time to leave such a fabulous review, we’re very happy to hear you had a great time. Many memorabiliaa genuine walk-through of music history. You might find Michael Jackson’s shoes, a guitar from a rock legend Billy Idol or an outfit worn by the icon Elvis Presley ( aka the King) . The attention to every detail in the décor is very notable . ​ ​The Menu like always a pure legendary in Every Bite .  Many thanks to Maher the owner and all the amazing staff that made our son birthday so unique . we are very appreciated that 🙏  We will definitely come back again . || Wow — what an incredible review! We’re truly thrilled to hear that you and your family had such a memorable experience with us at HRC Dubai. Thank you for noticing all the details — from the décor and memorabilia to the live music and menu — our team puts a lot of heart into creating that authentic Hard Rock atmosphere. We’ve been there a couple of times this month, had a super relaxed time. Kaz and Jr Brown were fantastic, especially Brown’s rock classics 🎸. Definitely one of the few places in Dubai that gets it right every time || Thanks for the amazing review and photos! Happy to know you always enjoy the food, vibe, and service. It's more than just a restaurant; it's a true rock 'n' roll destination. I ordered the Legendary Burger, Famous Fajitas, Mac & Cheese, and it was cooked to perfection. What really stood out, though, was the excellent service. The staff were incredibly welcoming, attentive, and efficient. They made sure I had everything I needed and were genuinely friendly, adding to the overall positive vibe of the place. It's clear they pride themselves on providing a top-notch experience for every guest. Whether you're a rock music fan, a foodie, or simply looking for a fun and lively dining experience in Dubai, Hard Rock Cafe is a must-visit. I left feeling happy, full, and already planning my next trip back to soak in more of that amazing atmosphere and try another item from their fantastic menu! || Thank you for the phenomenal review! We’re beyond thrilled to hear you had such a memorable experience at HRC Dubai – from the energy and music to the food and service. Huge thanks for the shoutout to our Legendary Burger, Fajitas, and Mac & Cheese – we're glad they hit the spot! And we couldn’t be prouder of our team for making you feel welcome and well looked after. Your words perfectly capture what we strive to deliver – more than just a meal, but an unforgettable experience. We look forward to seeing you again soon! || Overall 100% enjoy the food ambiance crew and management.  Well maintained dine Excellent performance @Pedro Barry very professional and accomodate || Thanks for the awesome review, we appreciate your comments! || I usually don't really rate and review chain restaurants, but I would like to mention here that the staff at Hard Rock Cafe Dubai was particularly friendly and helpful. Keep it up ! || We’re very glad that you chose to leave a great review for HRC Dubai! Come back soon. || Unforgettable Birthday at Hard Rock Cafe Dubai  We visited the Hard Rock Cafe Dubai on July 9, 2025 – a visit we had planned well in advance of our vacation. Since this day was also my birthday, my partner had mentioned during the reservation that we were planning to celebrate this special occasion as a family.  We arrived well before our reservation time and were warmly welcomed at the entrance. We had time to take some lovely photos and browse the shop downstairs. Once we headed up to the restaurant, we were greeted with a warm smile and guided to our table – perfectly placed with a great view of the stage and beautifully decorated with balloons. It was simply wonderful!  Our server, Afreena, introduced herself – and we were so lucky to have her! She is an amazing person, so kind and attentive. Our drinks and food were served promptly, and we took in the unique atmosphere while waiting – there's truly so much to discover at the Hard Rock Cafe!  One of the absolute highlights was the restaurant manager. He was so passionate and dedicated, personally visiting the tables, engaging with guests, and genuinely showing interest in the stories behind the people visiting his venue. That personal touch left a strong impression on us.  The food was excellent – especially the fries, which were honestly the best we’ve ever had!  After the meal, I was completely surprised: Afreena returned with the entire staff – including the manager – singing and bringing a birthday cake to our table. I was overwhelmed with joy and deeply touched. I had never experienced anything like it before.  To top it all off, there was fantastic live music that evening by Pedro Bray – a truly talented musician who definitely deserves much more recognition!  You made this evening so incredibly special for us. Thank you so, so much! We will always remember this day, the Hard Rock Cafe Dubai, and your amazing team with love and gratitude! || Thank you so much for the amazing  5-star review and for sharing your nice photos! We’re thrilled to hear your birthday celebration was truly unforgettable. It’s our pleasure to create such special moments, and we’re so glad our team made your day memorable. We can’t wait to welcome you and your family back soon! || Highly recommended! The restaurant has a very family-friendly atmosphere and is a great place to celebrate birthdays for all ages.  We celebrated my daughter’s 18th birthday here with a group of six people. It was her first time visiting Hard Rock, and the experience was truly memorable. The manager, staff, and crew were very warm, welcoming, and accommodating, which made us feel comfortable and well taken care of.  The food was very delicious, and the ambiance was excellent. A special thank you to the performer, Sir Pedro Barry, who was very professional and engaging—he truly made the celebration extra special.  Food: Excellent Ambiance: Excellent Management: Excellent Performer: Excellent Music: Excellent  Overall, the quality of food and service was outstanding. We had a wonderful celebration and will definitely come back. || Thank you for taking the time to leave such a fabulous review, we really appreciate the great feedback. I'll pass on your lovely comments to our team and to Pedro! || The place is very cozy and relaxing. The food is awesome and truly worth the price. The team is very friendly , the manager personally checks on each table to make sure everything is good, and the staff are equally attentive, especially Raquel, who was exceptionally super nice. Overall, a 10/10 experience! || Thank you for sharing such lovely comments, I’ll pass them onto our team. We hope to welcome you back soon! || Hard Rock Café in Festival City stays true to its well-known concept – a familiar atmosphere with great food and reliable service. We knew what to expect, and it certainly didn’t disappoint.  The staff were friendly and attentive, and our food arrived quickly and was just as tasty as we remembered. It’s always a solid choice for a casual meal in a lively setting.  The only minor downside was the live band, which played a bit too loud for our taste. While the energy was great, the volume made conversation a little tricky at times. That said, it didn’t ruin the experience – just something to be aware of if you’re looking for a quieter evening. || Thanks for taking the time to leave such a detailed review, I’ll pass on your comments regarding the live music to our higher management. place_name: 九龙港式茶餐厅 Hongkong Legend Kowloon Restaurant
reviews_content: We always come to this Chinese restaurant, and it never disappoints. They serve complimentary tea that tastes exceptionally good and is a great start to every meal. Our go-to dishes are the Macau fried meat and the stir-fried beef noodles—both are consistently delicious. Today we also tried their new mango dessert, which was refreshing and a perfect way to end the meal.  The staff are always very friendly, and the food comes out quickly every time. Highly recommended! || We tried Kowloon House Dubai and really enjoyed the food. We ordered the wonton noodles, char siew, egg tart, and prawn roll. The wonton noodles had a nice, comforting broth and the wontons were tender. The char siew was flavorful and juicy, not overly sweet. The egg tart was soft and creamy with a good flaky crust. The prawn roll was crispy and tasted fresh. Overall, good food, quick service, and a nice spot if you’re craving Hong Kong–style dishes. || We always love coming back to this Chinese restaurant in Dubai International City, because the quality of food is standard. It never disappoints and always tastes as delicious as it was the first time we dined here. reviews_content: Shoutout to Glen! He’s genuinely kind and friendly, and he makes the place feel comfortable the moment you walk up. The open lounge area is what really sets this place apart. Good vibeZzz. The coffee is rich and smooth—honestly some of the best you’ll find in Dubai. reviews_content: I had the most fantastic time at this place! The food was absolutely delicious, so flavorful and satisfying. A huge thank you to Paulina for recommending such a wonderful spot! The service was top notch  the waiters and waitresses were all so friendly, professional, and experienced. It's clear that they care about giving great service. I truly enjoyed my visit and I'II definitely be back! Big thanks to Thet , Amani , and Raji for making it all happen and ensuring we had a great time. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for great food and excellent service! || I stayed at the Premier Inn Hotel in Silicon Oasis, and had breakfast at Mr Toad’s Pub & Kitchen, which is inside the hotel.  It’s a lovely restaurant with a nice, calm ambiance. The staff were friendly and helpful, which made the experience even better.  There was a lot of variety on the menu – fresh fruits, seasonal juices, different types of bread, cheese, yoghurts, and eggs made to order (omelette, fried, poached, etc). The food was high quality and tasted great.  One thing that was a bit unexpected – there were a couple of flies around during breakfast, which needs to be looked into.  Overall, the price was reasonable and I would recommend it. || Hey Aamir Rauf, thanks a lot for sharing your experience with us! We're so happy to hear that you enjoyed the nice ambiance, friendly staff, and delicious food at Mr. Toad's Pub & Kitchen. Your recommendation means a lot to us! We'll make sure to take care of the fly situation. See you again soon! Mr. Toad's Pub & Kitchen Team. || It's peaceful for me. I loved my stay here. I like the foods as well. Very good services of the restau staffs- Renah, Sonish, Manish and Ben. They are very approachable and fast and know how to assist you with your concerns. The place is clean and quiet if you wanna relax your mind, this is a good place to stay. The lifeguard is not as much as strict and very attentive as well. || Hey Sarah, your review made our day! We strive to offer a welcoming atmosphere with great service and reasonable offers. We hope to see you again soon! Mr. Toad's Pub & Kitchen Team. || A positive dining experience at Mr. Toad's Pub & Kitchen, Silicon Oasis. The classic cheeseburger meal featured a high-quality, juicy patty with melted cheese on a soft potato bun. The fries were notably fresh, crisp, and not overly oily. Highly recommend for one of the better burgers in the area. || Hi Oussama, thank you for your positive feedback. We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed our classic cheeseburger meal. Your recommendation means a lot to us. Mr. Toad's Pub & Kitchen Team. || Lovely atmosphere, great food and portion sizes. Our waitress Renah, was so friendly and attentive thank you very much for having us. The Saturday brunch is great value for money compared to a lot of brunches in dubai. Soft package 129, house package 249 and premium package only 299. We would highly recommend. || The place super wonderful and we are the first people to grab and enjoyed the gentleman’s night for only 129 aed including 3 drafts beers I would highly thank chef Khairul and server Benedict for their amazing job and hospitality and I will come again for sure with more friends PS : could you help me out where I can get same stars tiles and wooden floor I would like to have them in my home 😊🙏 || Hi Mr. Sige, thank you so much for your fantastic feedback! We're delighted that you had a great time at gentleman’s night and that Chef Khairul and server Benedict took such good care of you. Can't wait to see you and your friends again soon! As for the tiles and wooden floor, try checking out local stores for a similar look.   Mr. Toad's Pub & Kitchen Team || What an absolute and superb experience at Mr. Toad’s Saturday Brunch in Silicon Oasis. From start to finish, everything exceeded our expectations.  The food was delicious — flavorful, fresh, and generously portioned. There were so many options to choose from, and I loved the variety of offers available. It’s honestly one of the most affordable brunches in Dubai, especially considering the quality and experience. You won’t find value like this anywhere else in the UAE.  The staff were exceptional — warm, approachable, and incredibly helpful. They went above and beyond with genuine initiative and made the experience feel even more welcoming.  The venue is spacious, making it perfect for groups or families, and the vibe was lively and fun thanks to live entertainment featuring a great singer. The drinks were refreshing and perfectly complemented the food.  Came here with bunch of friends and to celebrate my friend’s bday 🥳  To sum it up: Mr. Toad’s Saturday Brunch is worth far more than what you pay for. Highly, highly recommended! || Service is very good. Waiters and waitresses are respectful.  Wings and Nachos were not good.  Chairs / high-chairs are not comfortable at all. I hope they look into the seating comfort.. || Thank you for letting us know, Wael H. We're toad-ally sorry to hear this, and we would love to know can we make it up to you. Great music, sports on the screens, great service, and “the best roast in Dubai”? Yes please.  Pro tip: ask for the mushroom gravy if you’re having the chicken or veg roast. Bonus: valet parking available. || Thank you for your feedback! We look forward to welcoming you back soon! || We got an amazing deal from BiteClub Dubai for a Wednesday live music dinner at LSB Business Bay and it did not disappoint! 🎶❤️  Generous food portions, super attentive staff who kept checking on us, and a fantastic live band that set the perfect vibe. We had such a great time! Thanks to BiteClub and LSB team for the hospitality 💃🍽️🎤 || Thank you for your feedback! We look forward to welcoming you back soon! || LSB is just wow! On a positive note, the staff remained welcoming, friendly, and attentive throughout our visit. || The place has potential, but they really need to improve the taste and quality of the food. The quality needs to be enhanced. I find the flavor lacking—there’s something missing in the taste that needs improvement. The seafood sauce lacks a strong, flavorful kick. The chicken isn’t as crispy as expected. The bangus sisig seemed hastily made—it didn’t even feel like sisig at all.  As for the unlimited iced tea, it seemed like they were hesitant to serve more. If it’s truly unlimited, then they should just provide a pitcher, especially if they don’t want to keep refilling.  The success of a business doesn’t rely only on having friendly and polite staff—it also depends on how delicious the food being served is.  Also, not everyone has access to Wi-Fi to scan the digital menu. It would be better to have a visible physical menu available right when customers enter. Many customers prefer to see the menu immediately upon arriving.  Also, the restroom needs serious attention. There was no trash bin inside, which is very inconvenient—especially for female customers who need to dispose of tissue or sanitary napkins. There was no tissue provided either, and no hand wash soap available. These are basic necessities that should always be present in any customer restroom.  I really hope they take all of this feedback into consideration and make improvements for the future success of the business. The place has promise, but both the food and facilities need to meet customer expectations. || I understand that my meal was only good for two and priced at 89, but it’s not about the cost—it’s about the taste and quality. reviews_content: The ultimate spot for a group night out! We chose Woohoo for a long-overdue get-together with friends, and it was honestly the highlight of our trip. It’s easily the best international restaurant in Dubai if you’re looking for somewhere that has both a great vibe and incredible food.  The whole "vibe" is hard to describe until you see it—having an amazing dinner with AI environment made for such a cool backdrop to our night. It’s a total conversation starter! And did I tell you about how the AI environment made every picture you take look professional and very instagrammable? Seriously, our group photos came out looking like a professional photoshoot.  We shared a bunch of platters, and everyone agreed it’s the best sushi in the city. What really stood out, though, was the hospitality. We had exceptional futuristic dinner and service given by Chef Cristopher , Ms.Kosara and her staffs , who handled our large group so well and made us feel right at home.  Once we finished eating, we didn’t even want to leave, so we just stayed for the music and snap some photos.  Such a memorable night. If you’re planning a night out with friends, this is the place! || So happy to hear your group night was a hit at our best restaurant in Dubai. My family and I had a wonderful dining experience at Bu Qatir yesterday, thanks primarily to the outstanding quality of the food. The fish and prawns were remarkably fresh and cooked to perfection, with mild, well-balanced flavors that truly enhanced the natural taste of the seafood. A particular highlight was the fish curry gravy—flavorful gravy paired exquisitely with the Kerala porotta. The service was excellent and the staff were genuinely friendly and attentive, adding to the pleasant ambience.  However, our experience was significantly dampened by an extremely long wait for our food. After placing our order, we had to wait nearly 90 minutes for it to arrive. The restaurant was very crowded, and we observed that at one point, about 70% of the occupied tables were also waiting for their meals.  While the culinary quality is top-notch, such a prolonged wait time is difficult to manage, especially for families. I sincerely hope the management can address this operational bottleneck—perhaps by reviewing their kitchen workflow or managing table reservations differently during peak hours. Solving this would truly make Bu Qatir a flawless dining destination.  In short: Amazing food, great service, but be prepared for a potentially very long wait during busy times. || ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Bu Qtair – A Must-Visit for Seafood Lovers! The service was a real highlight; Chris made our lunch first-class. A great place to gather with friends and simply enjoy a wonderful evening. 🍷🔥 || Dear Mila,  Thank you for your amazing review! We’re delighted you enjoyed the food, wine selection, and the atmosphere of our terrace overlooking Ain Dubai and the surrounding area. It’s wonderful to hear that Chris provided you with exceptional service throughout your visit. We appreciate your patronage and look forward to welcoming you back soon.  Kind regards  Clay Dubai Team || WOW!  Best meal I have had in a long time.  I would eat here every weekend if I lived in Dubai.  Not only does Clay have a super cool vibe and decor, but the food is just amazing!  Every dish was absolutely delicious and beautifully presented. Not to be outshined by the food, the service was just outstanding.  If you love Asian fusion this is your place! || Dear Krista Breaux,  Thank you so much for your incredible review! We appreciate your recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back soon.  Kind regards  Clay Dubai Team || A great place to enjoy the japanese-peruvian fusion with a stunning backdrop of Bluewater.  Definitely the prettiest ceviche and guacamole that we tried in Dubai. The mains from the Business lunch - the Steak and the Grilled seabass were on point yet the sushi presentation stole the show for us. A special mention to Collet who explain every dish and was very friendly and helpful. If you are looking for a an elegant restaurant for a special occasion or simply a good dining experience- Clay is a perfect choice. || Dear Slava Noor,  Thank you for your wonderful review! We're delighted that our menu offering and Bluewaters backdrop made such a memorable impression. It’s wonderful to hear the ceviche, guacamole, and sushi presentation stood out, and that Collet provided you with excellent service. We appreciate your kind recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back again soon.  Kind regards  Clay Dubai Team || The food was astronomical! The service is impeccable and the view is spectacular! Can’t say enough good things about this restaurant. We had the business lunch and had an absolutely Amazing experience! Highly recommend. || Dear Sam j,  Thank you for your wonderful review! We’re thrilled to hear that the food, service, and views made your business lunch such an amazing experience. We appreciate your recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back soon.  Kind regards  Clay Dubai Team || Clay Dubai is one of the most unique fine dining experiences in Dubai, located on Bluewaters Island. This standout restaurant specializes in Nikkei cuisine, a fusion of Japanese and Peruvian flavors that delivers bold, balanced, and beautifully presented dishes. For those unfamiliar with Nikkei, Clay offers the perfect introduction of traditional Japanese techniques combined with vibrant Peruvian ingredients, creating a culinary experience that is both intriguing and memorable.  The ambiance at Clay Dubai is exceptional. The award-winning interior design is modern, artistic, and full of character. Rich marble surfaces, textured finishes, bold patterns, and striking art pieces make this one of the most Instagrammable restaurants in Dubai. Designed by a renowned interior architect, the space is as much a visual experience as it is a culinary one.  We started with the Avocado Nikkei, a flavorful mix of Rocoto chimichurri, onions, sweet potatoes, Acebichado sauce, and togarashi. The Thai salmon ceviche was fresh and zesty, made with lemongrass, chili, and mango, and served with crisp coconut crackers. The Yasai Tempura was light and crunchy, with a mix of asparagus, onion, shiso, mushroom, corn, and tofu, served with traditional Tentsuyu sauce.  Our mains included a beautifully presented sushi wheel—a nod to Dubai’s Al Ain Ferris wheel—featuring a variety of sushi rolls and nigiri served with dramatic dry ice. The uramaki and tuna nigiri were standout bites and a highlight for any sushi lover. The corn-fed chicken was tender and mildly spiced with chili and Shoyu, paired with purple potatoes topped with cheese. The Chilean sea bass, served over Nikkei rice with yellow chili and dashi, accompanied by a criolla salad, was delicate and flavorful. On the side, we enjoyed the broccolini, served al dente with a tangy balsamic ponzu dressing.  For dessert, we tried the churros served with a citrus fudge sauce—crispy and indulgent. The Yuzu cheesecake was a sophisticated blend of yuzu mousse, mango ginger foam, lime confit, and matcha crumble. || Dear Saadiya Ahmad,  Thank you for such a wonderful review! Your descriptions truly capture the essence of Clay. We're thrilled to hear that every element of your experience, from the Avocado Nikkei to the Yuzu cheesecake, left a lasting impression.  Your appreciation for the artistry and ambiance means the world to us, and we can't wait to welcome you back for another unforgettable culinary journey.  Kind regards  Clay Dubai Team
