We truly appreciate your recommendation and can’t wait to welcome you back for another memorable meal at Tom&Serg!  Team tomandserg || Breakfast in Al Quoz — at Tom & Serg  Started the day with the Baghdad Scramble: fluffy eggs, beef chorizo, creamy hummus, all next to a paratha — solid.  The real star? The French Toast. Layers of peanut butter praline, berry jelly, and maple syrup, topped with crème fraîche — unexpectedly perfect. Sweet, salty, tangy, rich. Brilliant balance in every bite.  Coffee was okay. But the industrial vibes, high ceilings, and natural light made up for it. A spot tucked between warehouses but full of charm.  —  Would I come back? For that toast — absolutely. || Dear Khaled, Really appreciate your thoughtful feedback! We’re so glad the Baghdad scrambled hit the spot and that the PB&J French toast was a highlight you’d come back for. Comments like yours inspire us to keep pushing for the best,and hopefully get that 5th star next time!  Team tomandserg || I finally visited Tom & Serge after hearing so much about it—and it definitely lived up to all expectations! I tried their new Crispy Rice Omelette, and it was absolutely delicious. I loved it so much that I’ve been ordering it for delivery ever since. Big thanks to our waiter, James, for the attentive and kind service, even during a packed house. No wonder this place is so popular!  They also serve amazing pastries and their own coffee, which you can buy and have ground on the spot. || Good spot for a late breakfast. Relaxed vibe, portions are big and there’s plenty of variety. Also feels quite comfortable if you want to work remotely. || Dear Kezban, We really appreciate your kind words! Happy to know the food, atmosphere, and workspace vibe worked well for you. Hope to see you back for another late breakfast soon.  Team tomandserg || I've been meaning to try Tom&Serg and today I got to, for the first time. I had a hard time deciding so I asked for recommendations. I settled with smoked salmon crumpets with soft boiled eggs. I paired this with the new Hibiscus cold drink and Spanish latte with condensed milk. I enjoyed the food so much and the ambiance is relaxed and laid back. The restaurant offers not just free cold drinks to delivery riders but filtered house water for all. There is available public paid parking outside and they also offer building ground parking for a fee.The food was served fairly quickly and the food servers were all very nice. One of them visited us halfway through our meal to check on us. But I have to give a well deserved shout out to James. He entertained us with answers to our questions about the history of Tom&Serg, who the owners are and fascinating trivia about the place. || Ordered the Aussie Benedict and a Spanish latte, both were amazing! The place has a cozy vibe, and the service was excellent. Special thanks to Ms. Ritchel for her warm and attentive service. Highly recommended! || Hi Bern,   Thank you for leaving such a good review. We are delighted to read your compliments and really glad to know that you enjoyed your dining experience.  We look forward to welcoming you again on your next visit.   Regards, TOM & SERG TEAM || I usually stop by Tom & Serg in Al Quoz for my morning coffee (and sometimes lunch!) since it’s in the same building as my work. The food is always fresh, the coffee is consistently good, and the atmosphere is perfect to start the day.  A special mention to Achini, she always assists me with a smile and makes the experience even better. Great service, great vibe, highly recommend! || Dear Rizza, Thank you for your continued support and kind words! We’re always happy to have you with us and look forward to your next visit.  Team Tomandserg. || ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐  One of the most memorable brunch experiences we’ve had in Dubai — Tom & Serg is absolutely worth the hype!  From the moment we stepped in, the space felt warm, airy, and full of life. The vibe is effortlessly cool, with natural light, greenery, and a buzzing atmosphere that makes you want to stay longer than planned. We were greeted by Jojo, who gave us outstanding service — attentive, friendly, and full of genuine positive energy. She made us feel instantly welcome and taken care of throughout.  Now, the food… wow. Every single dish was fresh, vibrant, and packed with flavor: 🥚 Green Turkish Eggs — beautifully spiced, creamy and fresh, with warm, pillowy flatbread that was the perfect accompaniment. 🥚 Turkish Eggs — equally fantastic, with a deliciously tangy tomato base, silky yogurt, and perfectly runny poached eggs. 🥑 Smashed Avocado with Marinated Tomato and Feta on Sourdough — generous, fresh, and bursting with flavor, with a lovely hint of zestiness from the lime. 🍓 PB&J French Toast — an absolute showstopper! Fluffy, indulgent, with berries and jam that hit the sweet spot without being too heavy. 🐟 Fish Tacos — light, crispy, and satisfying with a fresh zingy kick.  We also tried their fresh juices: 🍊 Orange Juice — pure, fresh, and just right. 🍏 Green Apple Juice — refreshing and not too sweet. 🍑 Peach Yuzu Spritzer — light, bubbly, and a great palate cleanser between bites.  The attention to detail in both plating and flavors really shines here (the food looked so good we couldn’t help but take lots of photos!). What also stood out was how balanced every dish was — rich flavors without feeling greasy or heavy.  Big thank you again to Jojo and the amazing kitchen team — we left happy, satisfied, and already planning our next visit.  If you’re visiting Dubai and love a good brunch, Tom & Serg needs to be on your list. Great food, vibrant atmosphere, and people who genuinely care about your experience — everything you want in a brunch spot. 10/10 recommend! || Breakfast at Tom & Serg is always a delightful experience. Atmosphere is good. Service is even better. But the food is the best.  Thanks to Retchel for being so hospitable and a good host. || My experience at this restaurant was average. The service was acceptable, but the food was very ordinary and did not meet expectations. Our seating location was uncomfortable, as the table was very close to the door, which did not close properly, allowing hot air to enter. This affected our experience, as we ate quickly due to the heat and were unable to fully enjoy the meal. || Dear Noura, Thank you for the glowing 5 stars! We’ll keep working hard to give you the best experience.  Team tomandserg || The iced mocha latte was great, and the croissant was delicious. Many thanks to Brother Sahan for his excellent assistance. I’ll definitely come back soon. Highly recommended! || Lovely service, the staff (Sahan) was warm and attentive from the start. The food was genuinely good, and even the water had a subtle flavor that made it feel a bit special.  The only real downside is the noise. The industrial-style interior looks modern, but it makes the space very loud. You can hear everything: the kitchen, the air conditioning, conversations, cutlery it all echoes.  Overall, a great place if you’re focused on food and service, but maybe not ideal if you’re after a quiet meal. || I think it is one of the top 3 places for single-item breakfasts in Dubai. Every dish we had was very delicious. BAGHDAD SCRAMBLE, the sauce added to the omelet was a perfect match. The spices in the SMASHED AVO & MARINATED TOMATO were excellent. The service was fast, and the staff were friendly. || Heard about this place from few friends . If you looking for Aussie style coffee, this is it . We had Turkish eggs and salmon bowl too. Everything was good . Got offered a desert as well by staff . Service was good and attentive . Only thing is parking which can be difficult but there is basement parking too. Would be nice if they can validate for their guest . || Amazing food, great atmosphere, Sahan served us and was very nice, and knowledgeable about the menu, the business and the background of the company. Coffee was great especially the turmeric and almond milk latte, the French toast , and Macadamia pancakes were amazing. Also had rice omelette which I would recommend, and eggs on toast with Granola Açai bowl. Protein shake was also really nice, fresh, whole food , good ingredients.

place_name: Ralph’s Coffee Mall of the Emirates
reviews_content: From the moment you step inside, this coffee shop redefines luxury. The ambiance is effortlessly elegant—warm lighting, refined décor, and a calm, inviting atmosphere that feels both exclusive and comfortable. Every detail, from the handcrafted furniture to the soft background music, reflects impeccable taste.  The coffee itself is nothing short of exceptional. Each cup is expertly crafted using premium, ethically sourced beans, delivering rich aroma, balanced flavor, and a silky finish. The baristas are true artisans—knowledgeable, attentive, and genuinely passionate about their craft.  What truly sets this place apart is the service. Thoughtful, personalized, and unhurried, it transforms a simple coffee break into a memorable ritual. Whether you’re here for a quiet moment of indulgence or a refined meeting, this coffee shop offers a flawless blend of luxury, comfort, and world-class quality. || Stopped for coffee at Ralph’s Coffee and I must say the decor was so typically Ralph! Had a latte and it was good! The perfect blend of coffee and milk. A very ‘Instagrammable’ cafe too! || A beautiful and calm café with a warm welcome from the staff. Their friendly smiles make customers feel comfortable and happy to stay. Many thanks to them. ☕✨ || Amazing experience at Ralph’s Coffee by Ralph Lauren in Mall of the Emirates! The desserts were divine, and the espresso tonic was a refreshing delight. Cozy interior with a chic entrance to the Polo Ralph Lauren showroom. Top-notch service || What an amazing experience! Having coffee at such a sophisticated brand and surprisingly, their drinks are cheaper than others and taste great too! I’ll definitely come back to try more. || I visited the cafe today and was quite busy but the staffs were so impressive and welcoming. Mustafa was soo amazing and the coffee was amazing, I ordered a flatwhite and iced Spanish. I strongly recommend the coffee, it's worthy trying and thanks to the staffs for being so amazing even during the busy times || Ralph’s Coffee – Mall of the Emirates The seating area is nice. We ordered a V60 and an Iced Spanish Latte. The coffee was good, but I’ve definitely had better. As for the dessert, it was okay. The service was also good. For me, it was an experience, but I wouldn’t repeat it. I’m a big fan of V60, and I found the taste here to be very average—definitely not something I’d come back for || The place is lovely. The pecan dessert was incredibly delicious, fresh, and soft. The chocolate cake and banana bread were below average, and the coffee was excellent. || Am amazing experience at Ralph’s coffee, good customer care services, perfect  for coffee that I took my Hot gingerbread. Surely another round will pass by to get more of the menu. The better atmosphere to cool off.👌👌👌 || Absolutely love Ralph’s! The matcha is amazing—smooth and flavorful. The decor is so charming and stylish, and the staff are incredibly attentive and kind. A perfect spot for a relaxing coffee break!

Walking back into Lolo House after a long time felt like returning to a place I didn’t realize I’d missed so much. The space still has that gorgeous, easy vibe that makes you want to stay longer than you planned, but what really made the visit unforgettable was Gladys.  I walked in absolutely starving and a little overwhelmed, and she was the perfect person to meet in that moment. She’s kind in that effortless, genuine way that immediately puts you at ease. She didn’t just take my order; she helped me figure out what would actually make me feel good right then. Her suggestion of toast and tea hit the spot, and the drink she recommended was honestly perfect. It wasn’t just service, it was care.  Gladys has this beautiful, warm energy that fills the room. She carries a positivity that makes Lolo House feel even more special. Places can have great food or great coffee, but when the people match that level of quality, it becomes something else entirely. And Lolo House really nails both. The coffee is excellent, the food is comforting and well-made, and the space itself has that creative, cozy charm that makes you want to linger.  But it’s people like Gladys who make the experience feel personal and memorable. She adds a kind of grace and goodness that you can’t manufacture.  Highly recommend Lolo House, and highly, highly recommend letting Gladys guide you if you’re lucky enough to be served by her. She truly makes the place shine. || Beautiful cafe with nice atmosphere for brunch and service staff was very friendly. I really like it that they provide physical menu the moment we say down instead of QR codes.  Best of both sandwich and matcha wete great combi! Highly recommended || Thank you so much for the lovely review! We are happy you enjoyed the atmosphere & friendly service. And for our physical menus, we know how nice it is to browse without a screen sometimes! Hope to see you again soon  :) || The place has a nice atmosphere with a minimalist and Scandinavian design. It's a good spot for group gatherings, as they offer private spaces for that. The second floor is a convenient facility for those looking to work, while the first floor has a unique feature a cycle store, which adds an interesting touch.  The menu is simple but well curated with a selection of nice options. Overall, it’s a nice spot to visit. || Thank you for your thoughtful review! We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed our minimalist and Scandinavian design, as well as our private spaces for group gatherings. || Folks, unbelievably cool. Let’s start with the decor , so good to see a truly authentic Dutch environment in Dubai . Super classy with amazing furniture . Came here for work and felt like having a great pleasure time . The owner was around and offered me some of their VIP area as there were some kids playing around . And don’t talk about the food , make sure to order the tuna salad, what a taste ! What a flavor and super healthy . Oh I forgot the amazing taste of the coffee. A must visit for work or if you want to have some great time with friends/ family || Thank you for the fantastic review! We're thrilled that you loved the authentic Dutch decor and found our furniture super classy. It's great to hear that the VIP area added to your experience and that you enjoyed both the tuna salad and our coffee. We’re glad you had a productive and enjoyable visit. Looking forward to having you and your friends or family back soon! ☕🥗😊 || Such a lovely and chill place. Beautiful interior, comfortable seating, lovely staff and most importantly great food and drinks! It’s great if you’re coming solo or with friends and family. || We were just strolling around and stumbled upon this hidden gem in Al Quoz — it’s absolutely adorable! The color palette inside the café gives such a cozy, homey vibe, and we were amazed by how beautifully it’s designed. If you work from home or simply need a quiet spot for some “me time,” this is definitely the place to be. Can’t wait to bring my friends here next time! || I was at Lolo house to attend an art workshop and really liked the place. It has a cozy welcoming vibe, and a separate space suitable for small events. The staff is friendly, my coffee was great, and other people said their food was delicious, too. Free wifi is available as well. || Thank you so much for your positive feedback! We're thrilled to hear that you enjoyed the art workshop and our cozy, welcoming atmosphere. We hope to see you again soon for more great experiences! || Hidden gem in Al Quoz! An open space, beautiful down to earth decor Dutch style cafe with a variety of seats to cater for everyone; remote workers and casual dinners. It is like an extension of your own home, and it makes you feel as though you’ve been transported to Netherlands.  I am equally impressed by the freshness and quality of their coffee and food! Delicious! At affordable prices, unlike other overly hiked price cafes nowadays, this place embodies humbleness on all facets.  The staff are warm, welcoming and care about your experience.  I am already planning to go back, bringing along friends and family. Good quality places with decent prices have now become rare, thank you for staying grounded and creating a sanctuary of your own for us to enjoy. || Thank you for the lovely review! We're over the moon to hear that you felt transported to the Netherlands with our decor and atmosphere. It's great to know you appreciated the freshness and quality of our food and coffee, as well as our fair pricing. Our team takes pride in creating a welcoming and humble space. Can't wait to have you and your friends or family back soon! ☕🌷😊 || Another hidden Gem here in Dubai! Great atmosphere, feels so at home! Will surely recommend coffees here to my fellow coffee addicts! Ordered the Best of Both sandwich and brownie for dessert and it was scrumptious! Freshly made and prepared! Simply satiated with my exerience here. Warm and cordial staff as well! Thanks so much! || Thank you for your amazing review! We're thrilled you found our place to be a hidden gem and enjoyed the atmosphere. Delighted to hear that the Best of Both sandwich and brownie hit the spot. Our team will be glad to know their warm service made your visit special. Looking forward to having you back soon for more scrumptious treats! ☕🍫😊 … || Would usually visit somewhere two or three times before making a judgement and leaving a review but felt compelled to leave one right away.  I've lived in Dubai for 12yrs and have my favorite places to go (Raw, NightJar, Cassette, Arrow Sparrow) but Lolo has jumped right up to the top of my list.  I stumbled across this beautiful place in the heart of Al Quoz by chance and it does everything so so well. Amazing service, great ambiance, lovely food and (important to me) fantastic coffee.  Will definitely be back...... hopefully before other people catch on and this place becomes too busy! || Wow, thank you for such an amazing review! We are honored to be mentioned alongside some of Dubai’s best-loved spots and to be on your list after just one visit. So glad you enjoyed the service, food and coffee. We can't wait to welcome you back soon. And don’t worry, we will always keep a seat for you available!

The drinks are very good quality - specifically the tea drinks. As a matcha drinker, the hojicha latte was very enjoyable. The raspberry matcha has potential, but it's not executed very well. The raspberry bits don't mix in well and there is not enough flavor for it. But the matcha is good. There is a lot of seating options both inside and outside. The staff are very attentive || I want to say a big thank you to Swostika for the amazing service. I was extremely happy with everything the food was delicious, and it was my first time at this café, but I absolutely loved it. The store was clean, beautifully decorated, and everything was just perfect 🤩. From the bottom of my heart, thank you to Swostika and the entire team 🙏. I’ll definitely be visiting again very soon. I love this place! || Love this place 😍 Tasty, high quality food, teas and coffees. Always an excellent, exceeding expectations. Very friendly and professional customer service, especially thank you to Manisha 😊 Strong recommendation! Excellent value for money. Try the grapefruit matcha, even if you're not (yet) a matcha lover😍 || A Crime Against Tea.  This venue proudly presents itself as a place of culture — located in the heart of Alserkal, surrounded by galleries and creative spaces — yet somehow manages to completely disregard the very essence of cultural appreciation it claims to represent.  They have a beautiful, spacious tea room, shelves lined with fine selections, menus filled with poetic descriptions and rare names. Everything about it whispers sophistication — until the tea is served.  An expensive Pu-erh is brewed for three-four minutes at 80–85°C, the leaves are thrown away immediately after, and the staff calmly insists that “it can’t be re-brewed.” The leaves barely have time to unfold; their life, aroma, and depth are wasted before they begin to speak.  In proper tea culture, Pu-erh is brewed in short infusions of 95-100 degrees water, again and again, gradually revealing its body and soul — each steep a conversation with time. To cut it off after a single rushed pour isn’t a misunderstanding. It’s vandalism.  And so the experience feels symbolic: a commercial place designed to generate money while hiding behind a façade of intellect and refinement. Everything looks cultured — except the culture itself.  A tragedy for tea lovers. A performance for everyone else.  As someone who studied tea in China and a mere human being looking for a tea place to read a book — I am genuinely upset, especially after I managed to have a conversation with a manager, who said that this place is designed for people who want to drink their tea "fast". It is a serious opportunity loss, because the food and environment here is great. || This little café is a hidden gem for tea lovers, but truly makes it shine is the amazing service — especially from Binod and Gladys.  Gladys greeted us with a warm smile and walked us through the menu, her knowledge and passion for tea were clear, and she made us feel instantly welcome.  Binod prepared our drinks with such care and attention to detail. You could tell he takes pride in his craft — the matcha latte he made was smooth, beautifully whisked!  The place itself is cozy and calming, but it’s Binod and Gladys who make the experience unforgettable. If you’re looking for a spot with quality tea and top-notch service, this is it. || Dear Hodan, Thank you for visiting Pekoe and for your review and rating.  We are very glad to learn that you enjoyed our tea selection.  But we are especially delighted to learn that you enjoyed the service provided by our team, namely Gladys & Binod. It's rare that a guest takes this much time to provide a detailed review of our team - only the kindest of people do. So thank you. We are very proud of our team and your recognition will only encourage them to do even better. We look forward to welcoming you back very soon. || A friend recommended me this place and it didn’t not disappoint. Everything was great & Ibrahim was so friendly - he took care of my table. Would definitely come again! || I loved that they had a clean option to order for breakfast which was the avocado, egg, protein bread toast. When I tried it I fell in love with the protein bread because it was so moist and soft when usually they are a bit dry so I have to order the bread to go! Swastika was the lovely lady who helped me. || The matcha is strong and rich—just the way we like it. Their bakery is a standout—super fresh with the perfect crunch, and a great variety of sweet and savory options. Lovely ambience to sit and relax. || Service and food were fantastic. Really helpful hosting from Manisha S. Really helped us pick our meals and settle in. || ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️  We visited Pekoe at Alserkal Avenue today with my parents, and it was an excellent experience from start to finish. The atmosphere is calm and stylish perfect for a relaxed afternoon coffee or tea.  Our server, Furqan, was fantastic warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. He took the time to explain the menu and made great recommendations that suited my parents’ tastes perfectly. The tea selection is impressive, and everything we ordered was beautifully presented and delicious.  It’s not easy to find a place that feels both modern and comfortable for older guests, but Pekoe managed it effortlessly. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Alserkal Avenue great service, great tea, and a lovely overall vibe.

Well spent AED 100/- brunch in this Japan vibe resto. The food tastes and looks amazing. The staff are friendly. Will come back soon to try other dishes 🎉 4 star for service - they missed the order of one of our colleague, and often gives the wrong food. For context, we are around 10 pax. || Really enjoyed my visit to Salmon Guru. The cocktail menu is special , playful, innovative, and delicious. The interior design and lighting make it a very cool spot to hang out. Service was good and the experience makes it worth it overall. A great place for cocktail lovers! || Amazing experience last night at the French Night! Kevin and his team offered outstanding hospitality very welcoming and attentive throughout the evening. The drinks were fantastic, the bar bites delicious, and the atmosphere with the music created such a great vibe. Thank you for a wonderful night, we’ll definitely be coming back! || What a night! This place truly deserves all the hype. The cocktails were absolutely outstanding -  perfectly balanced, creative, and honestly some of the best I’ve had in Dubai. The food and desserts were just as impressive, full of flavour and beautifully presented. Service was warm, attentive, and made the whole experience even better. If you’re looking for a spot that delivers 5-star cocktails, food, and vibes, this is the place. Highly recommend! || This place is a gem. Fresh breath from the classic Dubai style bars. Loved everything about it. The interior design the cocktails the ideas the staff. So happy I found it. || recently tried the business lunch offer and I was blown away by the value for money! For just AED 100, you get a choice of two starters, one main course, dessert, and even a glass of wine. The place has a funky, vibrant atmosphere that makes the whole experience even better. Highly recommend it for anyone looking for a great meal without breaking the bank. Definitely worth a visit! || I was planning to visit Salmon Guru since forever and I finally did today and it was absolutely amazing. The venue is lovely and they make the best cocktails in town. Their food menu is small but delightful. Overall we had a wonderful experience. Definitely would like to visit again to try the cocktails. || Went during mid week when not busy. Nice vibe, with good food and great cocktails (note their focus is on cocktails so VERY limited with other options). Be warned though that it is a very small space packed with seats and chairs so if it gets busy I would imagine it’s very crowded and uncomfortable. Tables are all very small too and food served on large elaborate dishes so challenging to eat comfortably at the table. Despite not being too busy, service at times was not very attentive. But the staff that did eventually serve us were very down to earth and personable. Another odd encounter is that they don’t have any tea on the menu and when my guest asked if he could get it from the hotel and bring it in they refused… a weird experience. I would suggest only going to get some good cocktails, and go mid week when not busy. || The place is just great! The cocktails for menu is amazing and you can choose whatever you like. My favourite part of the cocktails menu was: “What the …?” The interior is so cool you can observe it for hours. The ladies night offer is great! I would definitely recommend and will come back again. Thank you! || Best business lunch by far ‼️ For only 100 aed; you will have: • 2 starters • 1 main course • dessert • a glass of house wine  Isn’t that a steal??? 😱 moreover, the food is so delicious and beautifully crafted.  I also tried their cocktail, Kiss Me Now 🍹 🫶🏼 || Absolutely loved my experience at Salmon Guru! The food was outstanding — creative, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The atmosphere is vibrant and stylish, making it a perfect spot for a night out. The music added the perfect touch, creating an upbeat and fun vibe without being overpowering. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for a unique and memorable dining experience! || I absolutely love this place! The food, the atmosphere, the music, the staff, everything!  I love their chips and dip & obsessed with their short rib Bao bun (honestly best I’ve had in all of Dubai), the creative cocktails and mocktails are also so good!  Truly, I have nothing negative to stay about this place. Everyone should try it! || Fantastic cocktails, great atmosphere and knowledgeable and highly competent staff. The cocktail menu is impressive with plenty of choices for all tastes. They also make classic cocktails by request. My recommendations are ⭐️ Mad Bunny for sweet tooths 🍬 ⭐️ spicy mezcal Margarita 🍸 || The on trade hangout in dubai.  The party place where you can let loose without being fancy.  Great cocktails great staff. High skilll, high Fun!  Open late, always a vibe!  Shoutout MJ, Franco Elie and the team! || food and service was great!!!!! amazing place for lunch. haven’t been here in evening but they said it becomes quite busy so definitely reservations is needed. they have valet parking. and it’s free. they do stamp at the restaurant. || Oh woooow! This food, OMG! I came to try their business lunch, I had the vegan salad, taco bao, chipirones and chocolate brownie. Guys, I am telling you, you’ll love this place! Such a cool decoration, delicious food and high quality customer service! They know their stuff!  The cherry on the top of the cake is that this offer includes a glass of house wine! Wait no more and try it now!  Many thanks!! || @salmongurudubai 🍸 is a trendy cocktail bar and restaurant located in Dubai. The vibe is lively and sophisticated, with a chic and stylish ambiance, making it a popular spot for both locals and tourists. The interior is modern and vibrant, with a sleek bar area and comfortable seating options. The music is upbeat and the cocktails are the star of the show, crafted with creativity and precision by skilled mixologists. Overall, the vibe at Salmon Guru is energetic, fun, and perfect for a night out with friends or a special evening. Cheers! 🥳 || One of the coolest bars we’ve ever been to in Dubai. Super impressed with the design, the vibes and even the music was amazing! The best but were the drinks! Totally out of this world! The staff are super humble and friendly. Only bad thing to say was I wish my liver can handle more drinks otherwise I’d be there all night 😝  Overall I’d recommend this bar to anyone who wants a good change of scene and something different. || Salmon Guru in Dubai is the place to be, with cool vibes, bold decor, and an atmosphere that’s anything but ordinary. The food is inventive, the drinks are top-notch, and the whole place feels alive with energy. Definitely a spot that leaves an impression! Will definitely be back there for a drink or two. Highly recommended 👌 || I had high expectations when booking a table for 12 at Salmon Guru, but unfortunately, the experience fell short. Only 9 of us ended up attending, yet the restaurant initially insisted on charging us for all 12. After some back and forth, they agreed to reduce the charge — but still billed us for 10, which felt unfair.  Beyond the billing issue, the food was underwhelming. Portion sizes were very small and the flavors didn’t live up to the hype. It felt more style over substance.  The only redeeming part of the night was the music — great vibe and energy, which helped lighten an otherwise disappointing evening.

Bar Dali is my go-to spot in Dubai for Negronis — they absolutely nail the balance every time, and they’re dangerously easy to drink (in the best way). But the real standout for me is the Rosabella — not only is it delicious, but the presentation is next level, with a rose-carved ice that’s as beautiful as it is thoughtful. You can tell there’s real creativity and care behind every cocktail here. I was also lucky enough to catch their guest shift with Double Chicken Please (yes, the one from NYC that’s at the top of the World’s 50 Best Bars list), and it was honestly a one-of-a-kind experience. The energy, the drinks, the collaboration — everything about it was exceptional. It’s moments like that which make Bar Dali feel like more than just a bar — it’s a destination. Highly recommend to any cocktail lover. || Dear Tamanna,  Thank you for your fantastic review! We're so glad to be your go-to spot for Negronis and even more delighted that the Rosabella left such a memorable impression. Our team puts a lot of thought into every detail, so your recognition means the world.  We’re also thrilled you enjoyed the Double Chicken Please guest shift  it was a special night for us too, and we're glad it resonated with you.  Looking forward to welcoming you back for more unforgettable moments.  Best regards, Bar Dali Team || Absolutely fantastic experience at Bar Dali! I had the pleasure of trying the Royal Gymlet, crafted by the incredibly skillful bartender, Dennis. The drink was a revelation—perfectly balanced and bursting with flavor. The gin, preserved underwater in a secret location in the Persian Gulf, adds a unique twist that sets this cocktail apart from anything I've ever tasted. Dennis's expertise truly shines through in his mixology. I can't recommend Bar Dali enough for anyone seeking an extraordinary drinking experience. Can't wait to return! || Dear Hamed,  Thank you so much, for taking the time to share such a wonderful review! We’re truly delighted to hear that you had an exceptional experience at Bar Dali. The Royal Gimlet is indeed a special creation, and we’re thrilled that Dennis’s craftsmanship and attention to detail made such a strong impression. Your kind words mean a lot to our entire team and serve as great motivation. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon for another memorable visit!  Best Regards, Bar Dali Team || Wow What an incredible, tucked-away, bar. The journey to find it is worth it! place_name: BABA AL BAHAR SEAFOOD RESTAURANT JUMEIRAH
reviews_content: We visited BABA AL BAHAR and it was a celebration of freshness and flavor!  We were a group of 4 people ordered a variety of shrimp, crabs, and different seafood, and every dish was absolutely fresh and delicious.  The service was pleasant and attentive, the atmosphere was quiet and relaxed, and the prices were reasonable considering the high quality.  Convenient parking is available on site.  Highly recommend! The perfect spot for seafood lovers who appreciate freshness and great service. || Came here a couple times. I would say the seafood is really fresh, and you get a big selection on their menu. 4 of us paid 250aed for a full table of seafood, for this price, this place deserves 5 star. Squid and sea bass were delicious.  If I were to nitpick, the wait time is around 30-45 minutes cose they prepare the dishes fresh. Some dishes can be a tad too salty, but overall a great place for seafood lovers and a big group gathering. || One of my favorite restaurants in Dubai! reviews_content: One of my greatest steak experiences has truly been at RARE Brasserie & Bar.  The steak here is exceptional. I tried a Wagyu cut with truffle, and you can genuinely taste the truffle, not just smell it as decoration. Another steak we ordered was also perfectly cooked, juicy, and full of flavor. Clearly, they know exactly what they’re doing with meat.  The appetizers were excellent as well, including dishes like grilled skewers and fresh burrata-style starters. Everything was beautifully presented and well balanced. For dessert, we finished with a warm chocolate-based dessert served with ice cream, which was the perfect ending to the meal.  From appetizers to main course to dessert, everything was spot on. The service and staff were wonderful, attentive, and professional without being overbearing.  I truly enjoyed my time here and absolutely loved the experience. Highly recommended for anyone who appreciates high-quality steak and great service. || Hi Saj,    Your steak love letter has us smiling from ear to ear. That Wagyu with truffle? History and Origins of Old Dubai  The historical roots of Old Dubai date back to 1095, when geographer Abu Abdullah Al Bakri immortalized its existence in the prestigious Book of Geography. The city's maritime soul pulsated through fishing, shipbuilding, and maritime trade, shaping the primordial identity of this coastal settlement.  From fishing village to historic city The destiny of Old Dubai changed radically in 1833, when the visionary Maktoum bin Butti, leader of the Bani Yas tribe, led his people to the Shindagha Peninsula, proclaiming the settlement's independence. The economy flourished thanks to fishing and the pearl trade, key pillars until the advent of oil in the 1950s.  The arrival of the Umayyads in the 7th century brought Islam and new commercial opportunities, weaving a trade network that extended as far as Pakistan and India. The diplomatic turning point came in 1892, when Sheikh Maktoum forged a trade alliance with the British, followed by the farsighted decision in 1894 to grant tax exemptions to foreign merchants. || In the historic Al Fahidi district, you can get a glimpse of what life was like in old Dubai in the mid-19th century.  Here, an entire quarter of fishermen's and pearl divers' houses has been preserved and restored as a cultural heritage site.  The traditional wind towers act as a kind of air conditioning system from bygone days. The houses, built of coral stone and adorned with teak, palm, and sandalwood, are beautiful. The narrow alleyways tell a story of life before the establishment of the seven emirates. In its prime, the locality was capable of 60 housing units, most of which were separated by narrow, winding lanes. The town of Al Bastakiya was primarily built by the affluent Persian Merchants drawn to Dubai by the rich trade opportunities and incentives offered by the Emirati government; the district was named after the southern Iranian town of Bastak.  In the 1980s half of Al Bastakiya was destroyed to make way for the development of a new office complex. The remaining houses were mostly used as warehouses or accommodation for foreign laborers. In 1989, the Dubai Municipality directed that the remaining parts of Al Bastakiya were to be demolished. Rayner Otter, a British architect, came to the area and made extensive renovation in the house where he was staying. Rayner started a campaign to preserve the area and wrote a letter to Prince Charles, who was scheduled to visit Dubai that year. On his arrival, Prince Charles asked to visit Al Bastakiya and explored the whole area with Rayner Otter. During his visit the prince suggested that Al Bastakiya should be preserved and the demolition was cancelled. In 2005, a project was initiated by the Dubai Municipality to restore the localities of old buildings and lanes. The name was later changed from Al Bastakiya to Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood. || A nice area to visit while visiting Dubai. reviews_content: Juthoor Art Center, also known as the House of Sheikh Khalifa Bin Saeed Al Maktoum, is a cultural gem located in Bur Dubai. This historic residence has been meticulously restored to showcase traditional Arabian architecture and honor the legacy of Sheikh Saeed Al Maktoum, who governed Dubai from 1921 to 1958. || The Juthoor Art Center, formerly the House of Sheikh Khalifa bin Saeed Al Maktoum, is a cultural treasure in Bur Dubai. This historic residence, rebuilt and restored, showcases Arabian architecture and pays tribute to Sheikh Saeed Al Maktoum, who ruled Dubai from 1921 to 1958.  Originally built in 1896, the house was rebuilt faithfully beside the original site, retaining its exquisite details like teak doors, wooden lattice screens, and gypsum ventilation screens. The center houses the Dubai Museum of Historical Photographs and Documents, featuring captivating images of old Dubai from 1948 to 1953, as well as maritime heritage photos.  You'll also find a wealth of historical artifacts, including letters, maps, coins, and stamps that trace the Emirate's development. Conveniently located by the Dubai Creek, it's easily accessible from the Bur Dubai bus stand, metro station, and abra docks.  The Juthoor Art Center is a place to immerse in Dubai's rich history and cultural heritage, with occasional cultural exhibitions. It's a must-visit, particularly for first-time visitors to Dubai, offering a glimpse into the city's past and present. Whether you explore with family or on your own, it's a journey worth taking. || Very beautiful place. For those who loves art, you’ll like it. The View at The Palm is arguably the best observation deck in Dubai if you want to understand the sheer scale of the city’s engineering. Unlike the Burj Khalifa, where you are often too high to appreciate the details, this deck on the 52nd floor of The Palm Tower offers a perfect vantage point to see the palm shape of the island in its entirety. The experience begins with an interactive museum that details the construction history, which is genuinely interesting and adds context before you ascend. The view itself is a stunning 360-degree panorama. You get the symmetrical beauty of the Palm Jumeirah on one side and the towering Marina skyline and Ain Dubai on the other. Built in the 1960s under the late Sheikh Rashid bin Saeed Al Maktoum, Za’abeel Palace originally stood on the outskirts of a then-developing Dubai. Its name, “Za’abeel,” meaning “thanks” or “gratitude” in Arabic, reflects the nation’s values of respect, loyalty, and unity. Each time I bring groups here—whether from Europe, Asia, or the Americas—they’re always fascinated by the symbolism behind the palace. It becomes a moment of storytelling: I explain the royal family’s role, Sheikh Mohammed’s leadership, and his vision for Dubai. For many, Za’abeel Palace is more than just a landmark; it's a window into the soul of the UAE.  Guests are often intrigued by the palace’s connection to equestrian traditions. While the royal stables are private, I share stories of Sheikh Mohammed’s global achievements in horse racing. For those passionate about horses, this connection adds a meaningful layer to the visit.  During special times like Ramadan or UAE National Day, the area around the palace is beautifully decorated with lights and flags, enhancing the experience. Visitors often comment on the patriotism and unity they sense, even from outside the gates.  While our time at Za’abeel is brief, it consistently leaves a lasting impression. The harmony between nature, architecture, and history evokes respect and admiration. reviews_content: I almost didn’t want to write this review, because once the secret’s out, this place won’t be my little hidden gem anymore! But honestly, they deserve all the love. I’m absolutely blown away by this studio, it's spotless, beautifully aesthetic, and the best part: they have full-time instructors! That means no last-minute schedule roulette or mystery replacements.  I had a not-so-great experience at another studio just around the corner (yikes) But here, from the warm welcome at reception to the good vibes from the instructors and owners, you feel like you’re genuinely cared for.  Special shoutout to Emily ⭐️ she’s a star! Her energy is electric, her classes are fun, and she somehow makes you forget you’re working out (until the next day, of course).  Thank you all for creating such a positive and consistent space… even if it means I’ll soon be sharing my hidden gem with the rest of JVC! || We’re glad you did write the review. But don’t worry, whilst we’re getting very busy our full timetable starts in September offering more classes every day-and all classes feel like you’ve  found a hidden gem whenever you visit. || I recently attended an intermediate Pilates class here and wanted to share my experience honestly.  I am plus-size and have been working very hard on my health and strength. After losing weight and gaining confidence in my body, I decided to challenge myself by joining an intermediate class for the first time. The class was harder than beginner, but I completed all the exercises except one. That exercise was especially challenging for me due to my current strength level, my body weight, and the fact that I have scoliosis.  Despite the difficulty, I was proud of myself for showing up and pushing my limits.  After the class ended, everyone was congratulated on their performance. Instead of encouragement, the instructor made a joke in front of the group about how I don’t know my left from right. While I laughed it off in the moment, this is something I struggle with due to ADHD, and the comment made me feel uncomfortable.  Later, I was approached and told that I should stick to beginner classes. I explained that I’ve already completed beginner classes and that I was able to do nearly the entire workout. The response was that I should “do both.”  I appreciate feedback, but I believe it should be given privately and with empathy, especially when someone is clearly pushing themselves. There was no attempt to understand why I struggled with that one exercise.  Unfortunately, this experience ruined my day and made me feel like the hard work and progress I’ve made with my body were dismissed in a moment.  I do want to mention that I previously took a class at this studio with another instructor, and the experience was completely different. She was kind, supportive, and made sure I felt comfortable and encouraged rather than judged.  I hope this feedback helps create a more understanding and inclusive environment for everyone. || I booked an intermediate-level class through ClassPass, but I was 13 minutes late due to a traffic accident on the way. When I arrived, they told me I couldn’t join the class anymore, which I understood — but they could have at least transferred my booking to the next available session, especially since there was space. However, they refused to do that as well.  ClassPass refunded the credits I had used, but the next available class at 6:30 PM cost 22 credits instead of the 12 I originally paid. Unfortunately, no one was willing to help. The receptionist said she had contacted her manager, but nothing came out of it. Sadly, it seems to be a place focused only on money, with no regard for customer satisfaction. I ended up wasting both my time and extra taxi fare — and couldn’t even attend the class I paid for.  ...  Every business seems like a good one — until something goes wrong. What truly defines a good business is how it handles a problem once a customer faces one. And a reformer Pilates studio, where people go for both physical and mental wellbeing, should do the same.  Moreover, nowhere on your ClassPass page did it state that late arrivals would not be allowed to join the class — and when I asked your staff to show me that policy, they couldn’t.  If you genuinely aim to be a good business, perhaps start by making such details transparent — so others don’t end up wasting their time and money, leaving disappointed, just like I did. || We’re sorry your visit didn’t go as planned, but it’s important to clarify a few points for transparency with our wider community.  Our classes start promptly and, for safety reasons, we cannot allow entry after the 10 minute cutoff . This policy is in place to protect both the client and the instructor, and it’s something we communicate clearly to everyone — and apply consistently, without exceptions. Our receptionist followed this policy exactly as trained, and we fully support her decision.  Your booking was made via ClassPass, which means the studio does not receive any payment for no-shows or late arrivals — so to suggest that the decision was “about money” is simply incorrect. ClassPass handled your credit refund directly, as they always do in such cases.  We’re proud of our reputation for fairness, professionalism, and the quality of our sessions — reflected in the hundreds of 5-star reviews across both Google and ClassPass. The vast majority of our clients appreciate the structure, care, and consistency that make our studio what it is.  We wish you the best in finding another studio that suits your schedule and expectations. || I’m a total beginner and did my first ever class in the Reformery and now I’m hooked! Unfortunately, I came down with the flu and was unable to attend. While I completely understand and respect that cancellations and refunds are not permitted, and I was not seeking a refund, I was disappointed that the studio refused to allow me to either transfer my ticket to a friend (as a gift) or receive credit for a regular class.  Instead, I was informed that my spot would be resold to someone on the waitlist. This effectively means the studio benefits from selling the same spot twice, while a genuine client like myself loses 595 Dhs, without even the option of a transfer or class credit. It’s disheartening to see such a rigid policy that prioritises profit over customer care.  Adding to my disappointment, I was pressured by reception staff to confirm by 7pm whether I would be well enough to attend, even though the stated cancellation policy allows cancellations up to 12 hours before the class. In my case, that meant I should have had until 10.30pm to decide. However, as the studio closes at 7pm I was told they needed my answer early so they could “resell my spot.” Why not allow clients to assess how they’re feeling the following morning? A lot can change in 15 hours, and at that point I was still genuinely hoping to recover in time to participate.  As a Pilates instructor myself, I always prioritise health and body awareness. For many, including myself, 595 Dhs represents a significant amount to lose, and classes of this intensity require participants to be fully fit.  I believe studios should support and value their clients’ wellbeing and circumstances, especially when unforeseen issues arise. I hope this feedback encourages a more flexible and compassionate approach in the future, one that reflects the true values of the Pilates community: health, respect, and care, rather than rigid policies and profit-driven decisions. || We’re disappointed to see this review, especially given your background in the Pilates industry.   For clarity for others who are reading your review: all policies were made 100% transparent at the time of ticket purchase, and you confirmed your agreement when booking. These were premium, oversubscribed masterclasses with internationally recognized instructors, and fairness to the waitlist and other paying clients requires strict enforcement of terms.  To suggest that we “sold the same spot twice” is misleading. Your seat was held exclusively for you until you chose not to attend. When you confirmed you could not participate, that seat was simply released to the next client on the waitlist—exactly as outlined in our policies. That is not “double charging”; it is respecting both our instructors’ work and the long list of clients who wanted to attend.   Our team’s request for an early confirmation was not “pressure”—it was operational responsibility. Closing at 7:00 pm and finalising attendance for a next-morning masterclass gives the waitlist fair notice and ensures smooth, responsible capacity management. Perhaps at the studio where you normally teach or attend, waitlisted classes are less common, but here, this process is a necessity, not an option due to the demand.   Finally, invoking “values of the Pilates community” while at the same time posting a public review that questions another studio’s integrity does not reflect the collaborative spirit of that community. reviews_content: Visiting Legendaruim Museum Dubai was an absolutely magical experience! From the moment I entered, I felt like I had stepped into another world full of creativity, innovation, and wonder. The design of the museum is breathtaking—every corner is carefully crafted to spark imagination and transport you into different realms of fantasy and history.  The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, always ready to explain the stories and details behind the exhibits. What I loved most was how interactive the experience was—it’s not just about looking, but really feeling part of the journey. The lighting, sound effects, and overall atmosphere are done with such high quality that it feels like a true adventure.  It’s a perfect spot for families, friends, or even a solo visit. Kids will be enchanted, and adults will appreciate the creativity and artistry behind it all. Truly a hidden gem in Dubai, and one of the most unique attractions I’ve visited here.  If you’re looking for something unforgettable that combines entertainment, culture, and imagination, Legendaruim Museum is a must-visit. Highly recommended || ONE of it's kind of place! At the end of the visit there is a nice cafe where you can rest and enjoy a refreshing snack. || The Legendarium Fantastic Museum in Dubai Festival City offers an immersive journey through seven themed zones, featuring over 70 handcrafted mythical creatures created by more than 100 artists from around the world. Visitors can explore diverse realms, including enchanted forests, ancient tombs, and magical castles, each filled with detailed sculptures and interactive displays. The experience is designed to captivate both children and adults, making it a perfect family outing. It can get very hot walking between museums but each is airconditioned inside.  There was some confusion over where to buy an entry ticket as the main building told me to go the children's museum and then they sent me back but this was quickly sorted. I started my visit with the short 15 minute video in the theatre about the history of Dubai.  There are lots of little alleys to explore with various themed museums around each corner. You show the ticket QR code on your phone at each museum to gain entry. I was there mid afternoon on a Thursday and had the entire place to myself.  The displays are interactive, incorporating technology and audio visual effects along with artefacts and dioramas. My favourite museums were the archeology one, the perfume one, the food one and the culture of the sea.  Special mention to Noora at the Food House who gave me black coffee and dates on the floor mat and then took me on a private tour of the gallery and answered all the questions I had. I spent about 5 hours here and covered about 80% of the museums. All the staff were lovely. Strong recommend if you have a stopover and want to pass some time near the airport. Entry about $20AUD. || Pretty enjoyable. I was amazed by the interactivity and sense of technology here. They also offer free workshops where you can make handicrafts, depending on the date you come. I made a saffron rose candle inside an oyster shell and got to take it home. Najla, who was in charge of the workshop, was extremely friendly—I really enjoyed talking with her. All the staff were polite and welcoming. My favorite part was the interactive installations in the perfume gallery (you can smell more than twenty different scents), and the VR pearl diving experience in the ocean gallery was also a lot of fun. If you only have one afternoon in Dubai, you definitely have to come here!  Just so you know, the entire museum is located by the water, so when moving between the twenty or so galleries you can enjoy the waterfront scenery. The whole atmosphere is peaceful and pleasant (and it’s a perfect spot to watch the sunset!). You’ll also see lots of cats around. There’s even a museum gift shop. Nearby at the heritage house, a large bottle of water costs only 3 AED.  I especially loved the perfume gallery, where you can compare scents from different origins and learn to distinguish between animal, plant, and synthetic notes. As a perfume enthusiast, I really appreciated discovering the differences between oud from various regions, the contrasts among natural saffron, synthetic saffron, and ambergris, as well as between Taif rose essential oil and regular rose oil. Don’t forget to take a walk through the long corridor in the perfume gallery—there are plenty more scents to experience there too.  To sum up: If you’re interested in Arab culture, come! If you want to learn about Dubai’s development history, come! If you’d like to make your own handicraft and take it home for free, come! If you want to enjoy the comfort of air conditioning indoors while still admiring beautiful views outside, come! If you appreciate not only the elegant interior design and high-tech interactions but also natural settings with an Arabian touch, come! If you’re a perfume lover, this is a must! If you love cats, come! If you’d enjoy a sunset stroll by the water, come!  I honestly can’t think of a single reason not to visit. Even if my time in Dubai were limited next time, I’d still want to come back here again. Tip: Don’t forget to have a cup of Turkish coffee at the visitor center, along with a few delicious dates! || We visited the Shindagha Museum today with the students of Elite English School, and it was a wonderful experience! And Google shows the museum as being open so don’t rely on that.

I have paid over 7000 AED for this…….  I signed up for Warehouse Gym with a premium membership and also purchased 20 personal-training sessions. I went twice and quickly realized this facility is simply not for me — and the reason has nothing to do with the workouts, but everything to do with how they handle customers after payment, equipments.  Here’s my experience — you can decide for yourself what this says about their support and “care.”  I sent my first official email on 19 October about a safety concern inside the gym, dangerous equipments, HUGE safety concerns. No reply. I sent a second email on 24 October. Again, no reply. The first automated response finally arrived on 3 November — more than two weeks later.  During that entire period, despite their website promoting an active, healthy lifestyle, I was effectively stuck waiting for an answer with no guidance and no ability to safely continue training.  I also messaged multiple staff members on WhatsApp. I was repeatedly told “we’ll respond tomorrow,” yet the replies never came. Some days there was no answer at all, despite my follow-ups.  And here comes the part that really made me raise an eyebrow: while I was waiting for an answer to my safety concern for more than two weeks, I received two messages from different staff members trying to upsell me next month’s package. Draw your own conclusions — but personally, I get skeptical when sales move faster than support.  Regarding the facility itself: after my second visit, I scheduled an ice plunge session but had to cancel. The shower area only had warm water, not properly hot water — which is a basic requirement after cold exposure. Their response to this was, “towel dry, light movement.” It’s 2025 — after a cold plunge, customers shouldn’t have to warm up in the gym like it’s a survival challenge. Proper hot water is standard.  Finally, some machines I used did not meet my expected quality level, and one even caused me back discomfort. Based on the staff member:” the machines needs upgrade “ Well, good to know………  This is simply my experience — factual, documented, and based on my direct interaction. reviews_content: From the moment you arrive, valet parking makes the experience hassle-free. Once inside, the restaurant offers both spacious outdoor seating and a cozy indoor area.  The staff were very polite and friendly—my order was taken promptly, and drinks were served right away.  One downside, however, was the bartender. A simple Mexican-style beer was not prepared properly; the glass had too much salt and it wasn’t spread evenly. Also, there was a big fridge placed at the bar which blocked the view from the counter, taking away from the overall bar experience.  The atmosphere more than made up for it though, with live music by a talented Filipino singer adding to the lively yet relaxed vibe. It wasn’t too crowded, but everyone seemed to be enjoying themselves.  A special thanks to Lahiru, who thoughtfully called valet parking for my car and informed me once it arrived—so I didn’t have to wait outside in the humid weather.  Overall, a wonderful place with very reasonable prices and an impressive happy hour menu. I’d love to visit again and definitely recommend it! || Amazing food, always love the Lotus Stem, and Chilly chicken. Chicken Satay and Tom Yum soup are good too. Atmosphere and vibe is lively, energetic. I love that they have free valet parking. Too bad they stopped having Groupon :( || Located in DSO Digital Park with its own Valet Parking through P5, a small restaurant with a large outdoor space (not the best coolers) and a live band on a Saturday night.  Crispy Lotus Stem - excellent, served super hot.  Wild Mushroom Dumpling - very well cooked, perfectly filled  Crispy Chilli Chicken - big juicy fried chicken tossed in their sauce, a smarter way to avoid rubbery chicken sometimes served, this actually works, probably requires a bit more sauce. reviews_content: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Outstanding Personal Trainer & Exceptional Experience at J Club  From the moment we arrived at J Club at the Jumeirah Beach Hotel, we were made to feel genuinely welcome. The entire team was friendly, professional, and created a warm, motivating atmosphere. The facilities themselves were spotless — perfectly maintained, hygienic, and a pleasure to train in.  We chose Mary Joy Cormona as our personal trainer after receiving a strong recommendation — and she exceeded every expectation. With her background as a physiotherapist, we knew we’d be in safe hands, especially as my wife has struggled for some time with persistent hip and shoulder pain. Mary Joy immediately understood how to adapt exercises to ensure everything was both safe and effective, while still keeping sessions challenging and enjoyable.  Her enthusiasm, energy, and timekeeping were impeccable. Each session flew by thanks to her upbeat personality and constant encouragement. Mary Joy’s expert tips and techniques have made a remarkable difference to my wife’s confidence and mobility — she’s even started sharing Mary Joy’s methods with her gym friends back home!  Communication was effortless — Mary Joy was excellent on WhatsApp, always quick to respond and incredibly flexible with scheduling to fit around our plans. Beyond her professionalism, she brought warmth and kindness to every interaction. We truly feel we’ve gained not just an exceptional trainer, but a wonderful friend.  We can’t wait to train with Mary Joy again on our next visit. If you’re considering a personal trainer at J Club, don’t hesitate — Mary Joy is simply outstanding. || Very nice and clean place, well organized, with well maintained tennis courts. Great atmosphere to play and enjoy the game. || I absolutely love J Club! 🌴 It’s the perfect place where everything comes together — the beautiful private beach, the fully equipped gym, and great spaces for active sports like squash and tennis. The instructors are true professionals — knowledgeable, attentive, and motivating. The reception team is always friendly, polite, and welcoming, making every visit a pleasure. It’s my favorite spot in Dubai to relax, recharge, and stay active. Highly recommend! 💫 || I had a great private session with Physiotherapist Mary Joy. Thank you 😊 That was absolutely releasing the pressure around my diacogenic problems around my back. Mary Joy is a very competent and diligent physiotherapist with great knowledge and utmost dedication. I felt really in good hands. Great muscle and pressure release together with intense mobility training. Well done 👍🏼 I’ll be back for sure to repeat this amazing experience that I can only recommend 👏🏼 Thanks a lot to you, dear Mary Joy 🌻❤️ || ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Personal Trainer Recommendation  I’ve been training with Andrei at J Club for about 8 months, and the progress has been incredible. I started with rehab after an injury and constant daily pain, and he completely changed my confidence in the gym.  From day one, Andrei did a thorough assessment of my weaknesses and mobility and created a personalised programme that focused on strengthening the body while allowing it to heal naturally. It’s rare to find a trainer who’s professional yet personable; someone who can push you when you need it, but also listen and adjust when your body needs recovery.  I’ve improved my posture, stamina, and strength, and now I’m lifting heavier than ever. He’s very knowledgeable, professional, and genuinely cares - even sends workout plans while on leave and meal & recipe guides that goes beyond his clients gym performance. What has always stood out is his dedication.  Training with Andrei feels like working with a coach, therapist, and friend all in one. Highly recommend him if you want real, lasting results! || We had 10 wonderful days (10. to 20th October 25) at the Jumeirah Beach Hotel. Hygiene standards are low, hair everywhere,  changing rooms floor is so dirty we had to walk on towels. Shower top broken for a year, reported numerous times as i injured myself. Never fixed. No face towels, only oaper. Staff really nice but manager on the floor only when Dubai holding management is training. Juice bar impeccable service and product wise. We were 4 of us coming to the club all left after years. Not coming back as any commercial gym is better now. || I am deeply disappointed with my experience at Jumeirah Beach Hotel. As someone who frequently travels the world and stays in high-end hotels, I have never encountered such unprofessional and outright rude behavior from staff.  Today, I invited my friend and personal trainer to join me for a boxing session at the hotel’s fitness club. However, instead of assisting me with my request, the receptionist informed me that the club manager, Ivan, would address the situation. When Ivan arrived, his attitude was shockingly sarcastic, rude, and aggressive. He categorically refused to accommodate my request, citing hotel policies that allegedly prohibit personal training sessions. While I understand that policies exist, there is always room for flexibility, especially when it comes to guest satisfaction.  This lack of willingness to cooperate has forced me to make alternative arrangements outside the hotel. To continue practicing my favorite sport, I now have to spend 30 minutes traveling to and from another fitness club. This is a significant inconvenience and entirely unacceptable for a hotel of this caliber.  This experience not only ruined my day but left an overwhelmingly negative impression of the entire stay. It is evident that guest satisfaction is not a priority at Jumeirah Beach Hotel. I expected professionalism, attentiveness, and a solution-oriented approach, but instead, I was met with hostility and a lack of customer care.  I cannot recommend this hotel to anyone who values quality service and comfort. For the first time in my travels, I am eager to leave a place due to such poor treatment. The food is authentic and the service is very good. The place is a bit small but the atmosphere is cozy. We’ll definitely come back and try the other dishes. All the food we had today is 5/5 especially the dessert and soup. Serving is good for 2 people so the price is very good. || This is my first Time visiting Yum Thai Restaurant, I am so impressed by Burmese staff, P’Mon service. She has the best recommendation for the authentic Thai food and offering her assistance. All the recipes I make were so delicious and authentic. For sure my friends and I will come visit again. || The staffs are amazing and welcoming. Huge thanks to them. I had a wonderful dining experience at Yum Thai Restaurant. The food is truly authentic, with rich flavors that remind me of Thailand. Every dish was fresh, well-prepared, and beautifully presented. The restaurant also maintains a very clean and welcoming environment, which made the meal even more enjoyable. A great spot for anyone looking for genuine Thai cuisine in a comfortable setting. Highly recommended! || The food was absolutely delicious, and very authentic. When you ask for spicy, you get spicy! The staff were also very attentive and sweet. I would recommend the green papaya salad, the chicken mince salad (unfortunately didn’t get a picture), the pad thai with prawns, and the mango sticky rice. || Amazing food experience! The food is very authentic and tasty. All dishes we had were superb. The girl handling the service was very sweet and helpful and the little restaurant is squeaky clean, big plus. The best Thai food around, well done!! || This place is truly one of the most authentic Thai restaurants. I really enjoy their food, especially the mango sticky rice. However, the sad truth is that their takeaway portions are disappointing—the quantity just vanishes compared to dine-in. This time, I was really let down. I ordered mango sticky rice and instead of the usual topping, they used moong dal (Indian dal flakes). It felt like a compromise on quality, which is very disappointing. I hope they maintain the authenticity and stop cutting corners—it’s not fair to cheat loyal customers who love real Thai food. || Dear Swathy,  Thank you for your kind words and for appreciating the authenticity of our food, especially the mango sticky rice!  Honesty and consistency are core values for us. All our dine-in and takeaway portions are weighed on a scale (except for mango) to ensure consistency in quantity. However, mango size and flavor may vary slightly depending on the type and season, though we always select the best available.  As shown in our menu and practiced since day one, and as you rightly mentioned, we use Indian moong dal, which is similar to the traditional Thai topping known as “Thua Khiao Loe Phueak.” In Thailand, it’s a classic part of the dessert, typically served on the side so guests can add it according to their taste.  We truly value your feedback and are checking with our chefs to ensure consistency at every step. We’re delighted that you enjoy our food overall and look forward to serving you again soon for an even better experience. place_name: Lost World Aquarium at Aquaventure World
reviews_content: I’ve been to a lot of aquariums all around the world, but none have impressed me as much as The Lost World Aquarium!  The theming around the aquarium is spectacular, and it really makes you feel like you’re in the lost city of Atlantis. It’s impressive, immersive, and offers some fantastic interactions with the sea life.  It was busy when we visited, but it was easy to find quieter spaces.  Overall, it was an educational and enjoyable visit, and I would highly recommend a stopping by if you’re planning on visiting The Palm - it’s fantastic! || This is an absolutely beautiful place to visit. The aquarium is phenomenal,with tons of beautiful fish and marine creatures to see . It will take you a couple hours to walk through it all. Lots of food nearby also . The water park is really nice, lots of places to get under to hide from the Dubai heat . It’s worth going there especially for the price of it all . Hotel and lodging are there also . Amazing set up, quality aquarium displays with a vast array of sea creature all made up to feel like you are living in the lost world of Atlantis. Wonderful graphics and lighting accentuate the experience, giving a very unique, and lively atmosphere. This was the perfect place for us adults as well as our children ages 2 years and 9 years. There was even a live mermaid show that you cannot miss. We all had such a great time - highly recommend! || Lost Chambers Aquarium at Atlantis Dubai is a fascinating experience, especially for families and marine life lovers. The layout is beautifully designed with impressive displays of various species, including sharks, rays, and exotic fish. The ambiance inside truly reflects the mythical lost city theme, making it visually stunning and immersive. The educational elements and interactive touchpoints are a great bonus, especially for kids. However, the visit felt a bit short for the price paid, and it can get quite crowded during peak hours, slightly affecting the overall experience. Still, the variety of marine life and the peaceful underwater atmosphere make it well worth a visit. A great place to relax, explore, and appreciate the ocean world. || Lost World Aquarium is absolutely breathtaking! From the moment you walk in, you’re transported into a magical underwater universe filled with stunning marine life and incredible architecture. The redesigned spaces feel modern, immersive, and beautifully themed  every tank looks like a piece of art.  There are hundreds of species to see, including sharks, rays, jellyfish, and colorful tropical fish. The layout makes it easy to explore, and the atmosphere is relaxing and peaceful. The staff is knowledgeable and friendly, always ready to share interesting facts that make the experience even better.  It’s perfect for families, couples, or anyone who loves marine life. Truly unforgettable! || Very well presented aquarium with friendly staff who really seem keen to share their knowledge about the sea creatures. The main tank is huge and has so many amazing fish! The beach is open 24/7, with its facilities, food outlets, and activity operators generally available from daylight hours until late in the evening. The beach caters to a wide range of interests and fitness levels. It is renowned for its excellent kitesurfing conditions, with equipment rental and lessons readily offered by local operators. Visitors can also engage in other water sports such as stand-up paddleboarding, kayaking, jet skiing, and wakeboarding. For those who prefer land-based activities, a 14-kilometre padded track runs alongside the beach, perfect for jogging, cycling, and rollerblading. Additional amenities include free beach volleyball courts, an outdoor gym, and a dedicated skate park. Families are particularly well catered for, with children's play areas, trampolines, and the popular Aqua Fun inflatable water park, which requires paid entry. Those seeking relaxation can swim in the clear, lifeguard-patrolled waters, sunbathe on the soft sand, or rent sunbeds and umbrellas. The beach is also a favourite spot for photography, especially at sunset with the Burj Al Arab in the background. Practical facilities include clean restrooms, changing rooms, showers, and drinking water fountains, though it is important to note that locker facilities are not available for swimmers. Ample parking and a variety of dining options complete the offering. Visitors should be aware that the beach becomes exceptionally busy on weekends and are strongly advised not to miss the spectacular sunset views, which are particularly beautiful in the winter season. || Kite Beach is absolutely one of the best spots in Dubai! Beautiful studio with complete facilities like showers, toilets, free lockers. Very clean and inviting. Instructors were friendly and nice. Got a chance to join Pilates class for the first time and I enjoyed it. Totally different with what I am use to. Doing Pilates with great music, it’s fun! Highly recommend! There are parking spots outside the building (street parking ) and there’s paid valet, too. Will definitely come back soon! || Rev Reformer The studio itself is really nice, clean, modern, and very spacious, which made the environment feel welcoming and comfortable. The class was overall enjoyable. It had a good pace, felt engaging, and was slightly challenging, which I appreciated.  That said, the session also leaned more toward a beginner’s level in some ways. The instructor spent a lot of time introducing the reformer machine, explaining the movements in detail, and demonstrating each exercise. While this was helpful for those new to the equipment, it also meant there were periods where I was waiting around for the next exercise to begin. Because of this, the flow felt a little stop-and-go at times, rather than consistently dynamic.  I think it would be great if the studio offered a clearer separation of class levels, for example, specific sessions designed for complete beginners, and others tailored for more experienced or intermediate/advanced clients. That way, newcomers could get the attention they need without slowing down those who are ready for a faster-paced, more challenging workout.  Overall, the studio has great potential, and I’d happily come back, especially if they expand their class options to better suit different experience levels. || The gym is big and spacious, offering Pilates, spin, weights and more. The changing rooms, however, didn’t have anywhere to hang my abaya, which was a bit disappointing. The spin studio itself was spacious with good-quality bikes, but the class style wasn’t quite the same as the usual spin I’m used to at 1Rebel or similar studios. That said, the instructor was really lovely and welcoming. || Beautiful studio but reformer class structure needs work.  The studio is gorgeous and the front desk staff are lovely, but the reformer class itself didn’t flow well. The instructor spent a lot of time demonstrating between sets and each set required so many props and positional  changes and only had 5-7 reps so only about two-thirds of the class felt productive.  Everyone was asked to use the same spring setting regardless of weight or strength, which made some exercises impossible for me as a petite person. When I adjusted the springs, they were changed back, which didn’t make sense.  The music was also loud, and the instructor kept switching tracks between sets, further breaking the flow.  I really want this studio to do well, but the class structure needs smoother transitions, flexible spring options, and less downtime. || The studio itself is nice, aesthetic is lovely and modern and the staff are really nice and friendly.
